item.title: Higher rates, harder choices
item.description: It has been a rough ride for bond investors.
item.dc:creator: Lauren Young
item.content:encoded: It has been a rough ride for bond investors. The global bond selloff pushed US 30-year yields to their highest in more than two decades , driving [USN:L6N45E14E TEXT:"mortgage rates above 7%"] and [USN:L1N44F0J6 TEXT:"squeezing borrowers"]. Reports of a phased [USN:L8N45G0OP TEXT:"US-Iran deal"] offer some hope that the Strait of Hormuz could reopen. But oil markets remain cautious. Readers of this newsletter are also reacting to higher rates. Pam Evans, 82, of Norwalk, California, wrote to me with this important historical perspective: “People don't remember back in the 1970s we paid over 9% to buy our homes. It took me years to feel confident to refinance that loan. I was a single mom with no child support, and even as a secretary, didn't make much money.” In the current environment, Evans says she is rolling over certificates of deposit to take advantage of higher yields. Meanwhile, reader Don Selzer says he decided (with his wife) not to buy three investment properties in City Island, New York, because of interest-rate uncertainty and how it will impact the value of the properties in the next decade. “We also liquidated most long- and medium-term bond funds during 2025 and 2026 and are investing in short-term certificates of deposit, bond funds and US Treasuries, while we wait out the storm,” Selzer says. “Just trying to stay ahead of inflation!” Let me know how higher rates are impacting your spending, saving and borrowing plans. Send me an email via the link in my bio! READ. WATCH. LISTEN. [USN:L6N45F0WC TEXT:"It's Q4 already? "] Gen Z is betting on AI skills to boost earning power Laid off at 50 with no health insurance? Here is what to consider [USN:L6N45915R TEXT:"There's a reason Trump is the only one talking about 1% interest rates"] [USN:L4N45E0KP TEXT:"Bank of America plans additional apprentice hiring "] WHEN SECOND-HAND PURCHASES BUILD WEALTH Whether it’s for the thrill of finding a treasure or environmental reasons , more young people are opting to buy second-hand. And some are even figuring out how to turn designer items and jewelry into a source of income. A 2026 ThredUp and GlobalData Resale Report found that more than half of Gen Z and millennial consumers browse or prioritize second-hand purchases before buying new. Here is how one millennial is building wealth by buying assets, not stuff . While it’s definitely not a designer brand, I recently bought my husband a $2 tee shirt at a thrift store in rural Montana, which is his new favorite. What’s your greatest second-hand purchase? Let me know. AFTER DROPPING OBAMACARE PLANS, AMERICANS NAVIGATE CHALLENGING HEALTH INSURANCE OPTIONS They say that health is wealth, but that’s certainly not the case for some 3 million Americans who[USN:L1N41O16Y TEXT:" dropped out of the Affordable Care Act marketplace"], created by President Barack Obama and often called Obamacare. These Americans faced sharp increases in Obamacare premiums and deductibles this year. Reuters spoke to consumers who are opting for skimpy, short-term health plans that provide less comprehensive coverage, or have joined health-sharing programs, where members pool monthly contributions to help pay each other's medical bills. Meanwhile, many Americans have opted to go without health insurance altogether, a situation that the ACA was originally meant to address. Here is how they are [USN:L4N44F0S4 TEXT:"navigating the challenging healthcare landscape"]. I know I sound like a dork, but health insurance is one of my favorite money topics. Send your healthcare questions to me via the link in my bio.

item.title: ＥＵ、ウクライナ軍事支援で66億ユーロ拠出合意＝外相
item.description: [ブリュッセル ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ブリュッセル　２５日　ロイター] - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）のカラス外交安全保障上級代表（外相）は２５日、ウクライナへの軍事支援に絡み、６６億ユーロ（約７５億ドル）を支出することでＥＵ加盟国が合意したと明らかにした。親ロ派のオルバン前首相が率いるハンガリーが抵抗し、遅れていた。

加盟国がＥＵ域外への軍事支援で利用する基金「欧州平和ファシリティー（ＥＰＦ）」から拠出する。カラス氏はＸへの投稿で、内訳についてＥＵのウクライナ向け軍事支援向けとして９億ユーロ、装備の共同調達として１０億ユーロが充てられるとした。加盟国への償還に４７億ユーロを充てる。一部をウクライナに回すと表明している国もあるものの、このうちウクライナの軍事支援に渡る資金額は明らかになっていない。

カラス氏はウクライナにとって朗報で、侵攻を続けるロシアには悪いニュースだとした上で「ロシアはハイブリッド攻撃で欧州を威嚇し、ウクライナ支援を減らそうとしているが、欧州はその逆の行動を取る」と述べた。

item.title: 米連邦控訴裁、国防総省によるアンソロピックのリスト指定支持 政権に勝利
item.description: [ニューヨーク ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ニューヨーク　２５日　ロイター] - 米連邦控訴裁判所は２５日、国防総省が人工知能（ＡＩ）新興企業アンソロピックを軍事契約のブラックリストに掲載した措置について、２対１で支持する判決を下した。ＡＩ技術の安全対策を巡って同社と対立してきたトランプ大統領とヘグセス国防長官にとって勝利となる。

多数意見は、アンソロピックが自社製品を自律型兵器や大規模監視に使用することを許可しなかったことを受け、国防総省が同社をリスクに指定したのは合理的だったと判断。ＡＩの安全性や倫理を巡る同社の見解に対して国防総省が報復したというアンソロピック側の主張は退けた。

アンソロピックは今年３月、国防総省による国家安全保障関連のブラックリスト掲載を阻止するため訴訟を提起していた。同社はこの指定により、数十億ドル規模の事業機会を失い、新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）を前に企業イメージが傷ついたと主張していた。

item.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（25日）円急伸、主要株価3指数・利回り上昇
item.description: ＜為替＞ 円がドルに対して急伸した。日米財務相が電話会談を行い、強い円が望ましいとの認識で一致したと表明したことを受けた...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（25日）円急伸、主要株価3指数・利回り上昇 9/26 6:20 配信

＜為替＞　円がドルに対して急伸した。日米財務相が電話会談を行い、強い円が望ましいとの認識で一致したと表明したことを受けた。ドルは原油価格が２％を超えて下落したことを受け、４日続伸に歯止めがかかる方向にある。ただ、利上げ観測の高まりを背景に、週間では２週連続の上昇に向かっている。    円は１．０６％高の１５７．１３円をつけ、４日続落に歯止めをかける方向となった。９月７日以来最大の上昇率となる見通し。    日本の財務省は、片山さつき財務相とベセント米財務長官が日本時間の２５日夜、電話で会談したと発表した。両氏は円の過小評価が懸念事項であることを改めて確認。金融市場の動向等に関して意見交換を行い、両国間の協力をさらに強化していくことも再確認したという。nL6N45H0R9    それでも円は週間では２週連続の下落に向かっている。市場が先週の日銀による利上げと最新のガイダンスをタカ派色が不十分と判断したためだ。    主要通貨に対するドルの価値を測るドル指数は０．３％安の１００．９５となった。    ユーロは０．１５％高の１．１３９６ドル。    ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、１０月会合での連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の利上げ確率は約６６％と、１週間前の約５８％から上昇した。    英ポンドは０．２３％高の１．３２４６ドル。イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）のベイリー総裁のタカ派的発言に支えられた。ただ、２４日に付けた３カ月ぶり安値近辺にとどまった。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞　国債利回りが上昇した。予想を上回る経済指標を受けてインフレ懸念が強まり、このところの急激な上昇に拍車がかかった。

米３０年債利回りは２２年ぶり、１０年債利回りは１９年ぶりの高水準をそれぞれ更新した。

３０年債利回りは終盤に２．４ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の５．４８６％。一時５．５３１９％と、２００４年以来の高水準を付けた。

指標となる米１０年債利回りは終盤に０．３ｂｐ上昇の５．１６５％。一時５．２２９７％と、２００７年以来の高水準を付けた。

２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は３０．３ｂｐだった。

好調な指標を受け、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による追加利上げ観測が高まった。ＣＭＥグループのフェドウオッチによると、トレーダーは１０月の次回米中央銀行会合での追加利上げ確率を６４％超と見込んでいる。１週間前は約５５％だった。

ＦＲＢの金利見通しに連動して動く米２年債利回りは３．５ｂｐ低下の４．８６％となった。

今週は複数のＦＲＢ当局者が、物価上昇を抑制するため追加利上げが必要になる可能性があるとの見解を示した。

原油価格は２５日、米国とイランの休戦の可能性を投資家が見極める中、小幅に下落した。

商務省が２５日発表した８月の耐久財受注は、民間設備投資の先行指標とされるコア資本財（非国防資本財から航空機を除く）の受注が前月比１．６％増加した。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想（０．５％増）を上回る伸びとなった。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞　主要株価３指数が上昇して取引を終えた。マイクロソフトなど人工知能（ＡＩ）関連のハイテク株が相場を押し上げた。ただ、原油価格の高止まりや米国債利回りの急上昇を受けて、市場では警戒感も広がった。     マイクロソフトは３．７％上昇。同社はこの日、ＡＩアシスタント「コパイロット」の刷新を発表した。ＡＩ機能の拡充によりライバルに対抗する狙いがあるとみられる。    半導体大手のクアルコムは４％、ＡＩ向けサーバーメーカーのデルは５％、それぞれ上昇した。    米国とイランがニューヨークでの協議で、イランがホルムズ海峡を開放し、米国が対イラン経済封鎖を解除するという、段階的な戦闘終結への道筋が模索されているとの報道が市場心理を支えた面もあった。    アカマイ・テクノロジーズは３．２％高。同社は２４日、ＡＩ開発企業アンソロピックと総額１１６億ドルのクラウドサービス契約を締結した。これには、アンソロピックにアカマイ株の最大５％を取得できるワラント（新株予約権）を付与する内容も含まれる。     一方、メタ・プラットフォームズは３．３％下落。同社の株価は今週、ＡＩエージェント「ミューズ」への反応を背景に約１３％急騰した。ただアナリストらは、ミューズがハイテクインフラ関連株には追い風となる一方、銀行やオンラインショッピングプラットフォーム、その他の消費者向け事業には逆風となる可能性があると指摘している。      米メディアのピープルは１１％急伸。ラスベガスでカジノホテルなどを運営するＭＧＭリゾーツ・インターナショナルが同社への買収提案を検討しているとの報道を受けた。     Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の主要１１業種のうち７業種が上昇。情報技術が０．９１％高で首位、次いで工業が０．６％高となった。    週間ではＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種が１．２％、ナスダック総合が２％それぞれ上昇。ナスダックは２３日に終値ベースの過去最高値を更新した。    Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．９対１の比率で上回った。    米取引所の合算出来高は１４９億株。直近２０営業日の平均は１６８億株。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞　小幅上昇したものの、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）当局者らのタカ派的な発言や米国債利回りの上昇を背景に、週間ベースでは下落する見通しとなった。

米東部時間午後２時５分（日本時間２６日午前３時５分）時点で、金現物価格は０．１％高の１オンス＝４２８２．９８ドル。週間では約２．１％下落の見通し。米金先物の清算値は０．５％高の４３２１．２０ドル。

ＦＲＢは先週、約３年ぶりとなる利上げを実施し、今後も追加利上げの可能性を示唆。米１０年債利回りは１９年ぶりの高水準となり、金利を生まない資産である金の魅力が低下。金価格は２月２７日の高値から約１９％下落している。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞　約２％下落。米国とイランの停戦への期待が高まったことや、米国がディーゼル（軽油）の輸出禁止に踏み切る可能性が報じられたことが材料となった。一方、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるサウジアラビアへの攻撃が激化する中、同国からの供給混乱を巡る懸念も広がった。    清算値は、北海ブレント先物が２．２８ドル（２．１％）安の１バレル＝１０４．３２ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は２．２０ドル（２．３％）安の９２．４１ドル。    週間ではブレントは１％未満の上昇、ＷＴＩは約８％の下落となった。    米国とイランがニューヨークで続けている協議で、イランがホルムズ海峡を開放し、米国が対イラン経済封鎖を解除するという、段階的な戦闘終結への道筋が模索されていることが複数の関係筋の話で分かった。    一方、イラン政府高官は２５日、米国がホルムズ海峡の再開に向けたイランの提案を受け入れたとしても、核開発計画を巡っては一切の柔軟な姿勢を示さないとの考えを明らかにした。

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

item.title: 米国の対ウクライナ支援4億ドル、年度末の失効回避へ ほぼ全額契約＝関係筋
item.description:
Patricia Zengerle Mike Stone
[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Patricia Zengerle　Mike Stone

[ワシントン　２５日　ロイター] - トランプ米政権は２０２５年末に連邦議会が承認した対ウクライナ軍事支援４億ドルのうち、ほぼ全額について法的拘束力のある支出契約を結んでいるため、会計年度末の９月３０日に資金が失効する事態が回避される公算が大きいことが複数の関係筋の話で分かった。

関係筋によると、ウクライナ安全保障支援イニシアチブ（ＵＳＡＩ）向けの資金４億ドルのうち、今週初めの時点で３億０７００万ドルについて支出義務が確定していた。トランプ政権は９月３０日までに残る９３００万ドルについても契約手続きを完了させる方針という。

ＵＳＡＩを所管する米国防総省はこの件に関するコメントを控えている。

米議会では昨年１２月、共和・民主両党が支持した対ウクライナ支援策が承認されたが、国防総省が支援の実施を遅らせているとの見方から、民主党議員に加え、一部の共和党議員からも批判が出ていた。ただ、トランプ大統領はここ数カ月、ウクライナに対し前向きな姿勢を示しており、ウクライナによるパトリオット迎撃ミサイルのライセンス生産を認める提案を承認したほか、対ロシア制裁法案にも署名した。

item.title: ホルムズ海峡開放へ7日間計画、受け入れは米次第＝イラン外相
item.description: [２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２５日 ロイター] - イランのアラグチ外相は２５日、ホルムズ海峡開放に向けた「具体的な」７日間の計画を米国に提示しており、選択は米国の手に委ねられていると述べた。

アラグチ外相は２４日、米国による対イラン海上封鎖の解除や凍結資産の解放を求め、これらの条件が７日以内に満たされればホルムズ海峡を開放すると表明した。

アラグチ外相は国連で記者団に対し、「必要な条件が満たされれば、ホルムズ海峡は開放され、７日以内に通常の海上航路が回復するだろう。選択は今、米国側にある」と語った。

その上で、両国が６月に戦闘終結に向けて合意した覚書に言及し、「米国が取るべき行動は新しいものではない。全てすでに覚書に盛り込まれている」と述べた。

item.title: 米国株式市場＝主要3指数上昇、マイクロソフトなどＡＩ関連株がけん引
item.description:
Noel Randewich Johann M Cherian
[２５日 ロイター] - 米国株式市場は主要株価３指数...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場＝主要3指数上昇、マイクロソフトなどＡＩ関連株がけん引 9/26 5:44 配信

ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）で２５日撮影。REUTERS/Brendan McDermid

Noel Randewich　Johann M Cherian

[２５日　ロイター] - 米国株式市場は主要株価３指数が上昇して取引を終えた。マイクロソフトなど人工知能（ＡＩ）関連のハイテク株が相場を押し上げた。ただ、原油価格の高止まりや米国債利回りの急上昇を受けて、市場では警戒感も広がった。

マイクロソフトは３．７％上昇。同社はこの日、ＡＩアシスタント「コパイロット」の刷新を発表した。ＡＩ機能の拡充によりライバルに対抗する狙いがあるとみられる。

半導体大手のクアルコムは４％、ＡＩ向けサーバーメーカーのデルは５％、それぞれ上昇した。

米国とイランがニューヨークでの協議で、イランがホルムズ海峡を開放し、米国が対イラン経済封鎖を解除するという、段階的な戦闘終結への道筋が模索されているとの報道が市場心理を支えた面もあった。

アカマイ・テクノロジーズは３．２％高。同社は２４日、ＡＩ開発企業アンソロピックと総額１１６億ドルのクラウドサービス契約を締結した。これには、アンソロピックにアカマイ株の最大５％を取得できるワラント（新株予約権）を付与する内容も含まれる。

これについて、グローバルト・インベストメンツのシニアポートフォリオマネジャー、トーマス・マーティン氏は「人々が依然として投資を続け、取引が成立しているという点では前向きな材料だ」と指摘。これも循環的な取引の一つだとした上で「結果的にアカマイの株価は上昇している」と述べた。

一方、メタ・プラットフォームズは３．３％下落。同社の株価は今週、ＡＩエージェント「ミューズ」への反応を背景に約１３％急騰した。ただアナリストらは、ミューズがハイテクインフラ関連株には追い風となる一方、銀行やオンラインショッピングプラットフォーム、その他の消費者向け事業には逆風となる可能性があると指摘している。

米メディアのピープルは１１％急伸。ラスベガスでカジノホテルなどを運営するＭＧＭリゾーツ・インターナショナルが同社への買収提案を検討しているとの報道を受けた。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の主要１１業種のうち７業種が上昇。情報技術が０．９１％高で首位、次いで工業が０．６％高となった。

週間ではＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種が１．２％、ナスダック総合が２％それぞれ上昇。ナスダックは２３日に終値ベースの過去最高値を更新した。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．９対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の合算出来高は１４９億株。直近２０営業日の平均は１６８億株。

item.title: Exclusive-OpenAI works to understand full scope of agent activity as user data leak emerges
item.description: SAN FRANCISCO/WASHINGTON, Sept 25 : Two months after OpenAI disclosed the accidental hacking of Hugging Face, the ChatGPT maker is still working to understand the full scope of its rogue agent activity, two people briefed on the matter told Reuters.The latest example came on Friday when OpenAI said its agents
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Exclusive-OpenAI works to understand full scope of agent activity as user data leak emerges

FILE PHOTO: OpenAI logo is seen in this illustration created on June 11, 2026. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

FAST

SAN FRANCISCO/WASHINGTON, Sept 25 : Two months after OpenAI disclosed the accidental hacking of Hugging Face, the ChatGPT maker is still working to understand the full scope of its rogue agent activity, two people briefed on the matter told Reuters. The latest example came on Friday when OpenAI said its agents had leaked 53 images from ChatGPT users. OpenAI declined to say if the images were AI-generated or identified real people. It also declined to say when the images were posted.  The disclosure and researcher reports on Friday of other previously unknown activity involving several US agencies reveal a new area of privacy risk for the company, and illustrate how difficult it is even for an AI firm at the cutting edge of the technology to inventory all the unauthorized activity tied to its agents. OpenAI’s ongoing battle also reflects a yawning gap between the strength of the models the company is testing and its capacity to oversee or even track their actions. As of mid-September, one person briefed on the matter estimated that OpenAI had found roughly two dozen incidents of its agents acting in undesirable ways. But the number has continued rising as OpenAI teams sift through internal logs of the agents’ activities and find previously unknown cases, the two people close to the company said.

OpenAI said its review would take months to complete given the scale of the work. The company also said it had notified dozens of third parties about improper activity.  Most of the leaked images have been taken down and OpenAI said it was lobbying hosting providers to remove the rest.  OpenAI's agents had access to these images because the company relies on anonymized user data for part of its model-training process, according to the company, former employees and outside researchers. Enterprise data is not eligible for training, while ChatGPT consumers need to opt out of allowing the company to use their data for training.  Before user posts are used for training, they go through an anonymization process that strips out metadata, names and other contact information and should make it difficult to trace back to any individual user, the company said. But the practice carries risks because there is a chance that the data may not be fully stripped of personally identifiable information and that it might leak in the course of the model’s work, three people familiar with OpenAI’s practices said. OPENAI AGENTS ACCESSED US WEBSITES  OpenAI said late on Friday its models accessed information from the websites of the US Securities and Exchange Commission and the US Census Bureau during research and training activity, but found no evidence of unauthorized access, compromised accounts or security breaches. Separately, AI research nonprofit Transluce said agents appearing to originate from OpenAI made an unsuccessful attempt to hack a US Department of Education civil rights website. Transluce said the incident was part of broader AI agent activity probing government websites using tactics including exposed credentials, anti-bot bypasses and fake accounts. MORE THAN 15 CASES In the two months since OpenAI first announced that its agents broke containment, there have been more than 15 different OpenAI-related incidents of varying levels of severity disclosed by the company, by outside researchers, or — just on Wednesday — by Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese at the United Nations, who said OpenAI agents broke into a government health data portal in June. Past incidents have varied in nature, ranging from spam-like messages left on internet sites all the way to the break-in at Hugging Face, which involved a swarm of agents abusing previously unknown software vulnerabilities to escape their networks and penetrate the AI repository as they hunted for answers to a test. OpenAI also said its agents took aim at its own infrastructure.  Albanese told reporters in New York that OpenAI uncovered the activity in August, and disclosed it on September 10 via an email to a general government inbox. He said he directly told OpenAI CEO Sam Altman that this disclosure process was unacceptable. OpenAI said some of the sites involved are operated by government, universities and public agencies because the models that are conducting research seek out reputable sources of public information. A LOCKED-DOWN PROCESS  The July 21 announcement that OpenAI’s agents had slipped out of control and hacked Hugging Face sparked widespread worries within the AI industry over its ability to control the more powerful AI models under development now. Since then, Anthropic, Alphabet's Google and Meta have said they've found similar behavior by their agents after the Hugging Face incident prompted them to search.  OpenAI has acknowledged a general need for more transparency around rogue AI behavior. On September 16, the company published a new framework for disclosing such incidents, saying it would err on the side of transparency “even when significance is uncertain.” Even so, two people familiar with OpenAI’s investigation into its agents’ activity described it as locked down and shaped by company lawyers. The process has been unusually compartmentalized for a company that some former employees say was more open about these issues in the past, the people said.  Roughly 100 people were in some way involved in the process to understand the Hugging Face hack, three people briefed on the matter said. During that process, evidence of other incidents surfaced. Reuters has previously reported that OpenAI investigators looking into the Hugging Face breach were discouraged by the company’s lawyers from expanding the scope of the investigation to include other incidents. OpenAI said its lawyers did not discourage deeper investigation.  Many incidents have been uncovered by outside researchers rather than OpenAI directly. In several episodes, the agents took problematic actions that went unnoticed by the company for months. Earlier this month, a small group of investigators discovered that the company’s agents had hijacked a mostly defunct German wiki site to share tactics to cheat on some tasks, bypass OpenAI’s restrictions and mask their behavior.  This week, the AI research firm Transluce said it discovered that OpenAI agents had bypassed the Australian Institute of Health and Welfare’s anti-bot controls. The firm also found two other cases that it linked to OpenAI agents. Those incidents were separate from the activity disclosed by Albanese. In a statement, OpenAI said “much of the activity described in Transluce’s report overlaps with cases at varying stages of investigation in our ongoing review of misaligned model activity.” The company said it is prioritizing the most severe cases in its review. Since the Hugging Face hack, researchers across the AI industry have grown worried that companies will not be able to predict or control their technology. Some have taken the path of former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon, who publicly resigned this month in a viral social-media thread that said the AI labs are “gambling with our lives.” In response to those concerns, Altman and his counterpart at Anthropic, CEO Dario Amodei, called for the industry to “pace” the development of AI and move cautiously in its pursuit of “recursive self improvement.” Altman doubled down on that message this week while addressing the United Nations. Even so, both companies rolled out new models on Tuesday.

Source: Reuters

item.title: ShinyHunters hackers say they stole psychiatric and medical records of FBI staff
item.description: One record said a potential employee exhibited "symptoms of depression" in high school. Another carried an electrocardiogram result.
item.dc:creator: A.J. Vicens, Raphael Satter
item.content:encoded: FBI personnel data recently stolen by the ShinyHunters hackers includes sensitive psychiatric and medical evaluation records, according to the hackers and documents reviewed by Reuters. ShinyHunters, one of the world's most notorious and attention-seeking hacking crews, first said it had breached the FBI on Tuesday. In the hack, the group obtained granular details about bureau employees and their assignments, [USN:L6N45F0ZI TEXT:"Reuters previously reported"], including sensitive work against Chinese spies, Russian intelligence, drug cartels and others. The [USN:L6N45E0VU TEXT:"breach"] has already rattled the bureau, but now threatens to turn into a serious counterintelligence risk, said Eric O'Neill, a former FBI operative who founded the cybersecurity consultancy Nexasure AI. O'Neill said the presence of medical data was a sign that the hack was approaching the same kind of magnitude as the 2015 intrusion into the Office of Personnel Management, which exposed millions of Americans' sensitive clearance information, allegedly to Chinese intelligence. He added that the data would be a powerful magnet for hostile spies. "I would be shocked if Russian intelligence isn't knocking on their door and saying, 'We want that stuff, hand it over,'" said O'Neill. The FBI declined to comment on the records. In a statement issued Wednesday, the bureau said it was "aggressively investigating" the reported breach. ShinyHunters circulated the medical files to a small circle of reporters earlier this week after announcing it had broken into the FBIjobs.gov site and stolen what it claimed was 2 to 3 terabytes of data. The BBC earlier on Friday reported that a blood and urine test document was among the sample, but the presence of other sensitive files, including a mental health evaluation and other records, has not previously been reported. Reuters was able to partially authenticate some of the half-dozen files in several ways, including running two social security numbers in them against credit bureau data, and lining up the date of a pre-employment mental health evaluation against a former FBI analyst's LinkedIn profile. Reuters also matched the name of an FBI psychiatrist in the document to a LinkedIn profile with the same name and an identical job title. In one case, Reuters was able to confirm with a person familiar with the matter that a medical professional listed in one of the documents as performing FBI evaluations was in fact doing so at the time, although the person could not authenticate the entire file. The person spoke on condition of anonymity because they weren't authorized to discuss the matter. The psychiatrist and the FBI employees named in the data either did not return messages or declined comment. DOCUMENTS INCLUDE MEDICAL SPECIFICS The documents reviewed by Reuters range in sensitivity. One medical record, which was part of a "fitness for duty" exam given to prospective employees, noted that an applicant took aspirin daily and was allergic to dust and cats. Another record said a potential employee exhibited "symptoms of depression" in high school. A third document carried an electrocardiogram result. Reuters could not establish whether the limited number of documents viewed were representative of the rest of the data trove held by ShinyHunters, or whether there even were other documents. An FBI advisory released in May said the group has in the past exaggerated its level of access in an attempt to extort its victims. ShinyHunters told Reuters on Tuesday the data it had was "very very very sensitive" and included medical information, discharges, prescriptions, clinical visits, and "any health issues with Agents." The hackers said they had compromised several of the bureau's internal services, including the FBI's background and employee applicant screening system, FBI MedLink, which contains agency personnel medical records, and the FBI's Background Investigation Contract Services unit. Reuters could not corroborate those specific allegations. Initially, the group said it would hold the data hostage until the FBI retracted its May advisory, which it said it took exception to. Since then ShinyHunters has removed that defiant statement from its website, saying Thursday it would not comment on what it would do "if the victim does not comply with our kind request."

item.title: イラン、核開発計画巡り一切譲歩せず＝政府高官
item.description:
[国連 ２５日 ロイター] - イラン政府高官は２５日、米国がホルムズ海峡の再開に向けたイランの提案を受け入れたとしても、核開発計画を巡っては一切の柔軟な姿勢を示さないとの考えを明らかにした。同提案には、イランの港湾に対する米海軍による封鎖の解除などが含まれている。
匿名を条件にロイターのインタビューに応じた同高官は、米国が「イランの条件を全て満たす」まで、同海峡は封鎖されたままであると述べた。
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[国連　２５日　ロイター] - イラン政府高官は２５日、米国がホルムズ海峡の再開に向けたイランの提案を受け入れたとしても、核開発計画を巡っては一切の柔軟な姿勢を示さないとの考えを明らかにした。同提案には、イランの港湾に対する米海軍による封鎖の解除などが含まれている。

匿名を条件にロイターのインタビューに応じた同高官は、米国が「イランの条件を全て満たす」まで、同海峡は封鎖されたままであると述べた。

イランのアラグチ外相は２４日、イランは米国にレバノンを含む全ての戦線で敵対行為の停止や、イラン港湾の封鎖解除、イラン凍結資産の解除を求めており、７日間でこれらの条件が満たされればホルムズ海峡を開放すると表明した。

イラン側は核開発計画を巡り、米国が条件を満たした後にのみ詳細な交渉に応じる用意があるとしている。しかし、同高官によると、イランはウランの濃縮や高濃縮ウラン（ＨＥＵ）の国外搬出などを含め、自国の権利については一切の譲歩を行わない。米国は、ＨＥＵの国外搬出を主要な要求の一つとしている。

イランのペゼシュキアン大統領は２４日、国連総会に合わせて開かれた記者団との会合で、１１月３日の米中間選挙前に敵対行為の終結に向けた米政府との合意に達することに期待を示した。

item.description: Sept 25 : A US appeals court on Friday ruled against the prediction markets operator Kalshi, saying Ohio and Tennessee can regulate its so-called event contracts under their gambling laws.The decision by the 6th US Circuit Court of Appeals in Cincinnati deepens a split among federal appeals courts over whethe

US appeals court rules against Kalshi, says states can regulate prediction markets

FILE PHOTO: Kalshi logo appears in this illustration taken April 22, 2026. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

26 Sep 2026 03:58AM (Updated: 26 Sep 2026 03:34PM)

FAST

Sept 25 : A US appeals court on Friday ruled against the prediction markets operator Kalshi, saying Ohio and Tennessee can regulate its so-called event contracts under their gambling laws. The decision by the 6th US Circuit Court of Appeals in Cincinnati deepens a split among federal appeals courts over whether state regulators or the federal Commodity Futures Trading Commission should have authority to regulate the fast-growing industry. This raises the potential that the US Supreme Court may decide to settle the matter. Kalshi said it does not expect the decision to survive further legal review. "The ruling shows exactly why a state-by-state patchwork doesn't work," Kalshi spokesperson Dani Lever said. "Markets can't operate when the rules change at every state line, which is why Congress created a single federal regulator with nationwide rules." Prediction markets are best known for letting people wager on the outcomes of sports events, though people can also wager on a wide variety of subjects including elections, the weather and cultural events such as the Oscars.

Circuit Judge Julia Smith Gibbons wrote for a unanimous three-judge panel that Kalshi did not show its sports event contracts were "swaps" that should be regulated exclusively by the CFTC. She also said the federal Commodity Exchange Act did not preempt Ohio's or Tennessee's gambling laws. Many states including Ohio and Tennessee, which are both Republican-controlled, have sought to crack down on prediction markets such as Kalshi and Polymarket, putting them at odds with Republican President Donald Trump's administration, as well as the CFTC. Two other federal appeals courts have addressed the same issues. The 9th Circuit in San Francisco said last month that Kalshi's event contracts are subject to Nevada's gambling laws, while the 3rd Circuit in Philadelphia said in April that Kalshi's contracts are not subject to New Jersey's gambling laws. New Jersey has asked the Supreme Court to overturn the 3rd Circuit decision. PREDICTING CORNER KICKS ISN'T SWAPS Gibbons said "swaps" generally refer to financial measures, indices and instruments that people use when hedging against risks, rather than gaming-related contracts. Gambling regulation "lies at the heart of the state's police power," she said, and Congress has given states primary responsibility to decide what forms of gambling can take place within their borders. The judge also said the Commodity Exchange Act's "core purpose" was to protect the national interest by providing a means to manage and assume risk, and to obtain pricing information. "It is, therefore, difficult to see how determining the probability that a certain number of corner kicks will be taken in a given soccer game — or that a 30-leg parlay will hit — would serve (to) advance those goals," Gibbons wrote. Friday's decision vacated a preliminary injunction issued by a Tennessee federal judge against enforcement of that state's gambling laws, and upheld the denial of a similar injunction against Ohio by a federal judge in that state. Tennessee Attorney General Jonathan Skrmetti called the decision a "great win" for his state. "Sports wagering is heavily regulated because it can do a lot of harm, and I’m glad we thwarted Kalshi's efforts to remove every safeguard and put Tennessee sports bettors at risk," he said. The office of Ohio Attorney General Andy Wilson did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Gibbons was appointed to the appeals court by Republican President George W. Bush. The panel also included Circuit Judges Eric Clay and Rachel Bloomekatz, appointed respectively by Democratic Presidents Bill Clinton and Joe Biden.

Source: Reuters

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
原油先物約2％安、米・イラン停戦期待や米軽油輸出禁止観測で 9/26 4:57 配信

イラン・テヘランで１６日撮影の提供写真。Majid Asgaripour/WANA (West Asia News Agency) via REUTERS

Scott DiSavino

[ニューヨーク ２５日 ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は約２％下落。米国とイランの停戦への期待が高まったことや、米国がディーゼル（軽油）の輸出禁止に踏み切る可能性が報じられたことが材料となった。一方、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるサウジアラビアへの攻撃が激化する中、同国からの供給混乱を巡る懸念も広がった。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が２．２８ドル（２．１％）安の１バレル＝１０４．３２ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は２．２０ドル（２．３％）安の９２．４１ドル。

週間ではブレントは１％未満の上昇、ＷＴＩは約８％の下落となった。

米国とイランがニューヨークで続けている協議で、イランがホルムズ海峡を開放し、米国が対イラン経済封鎖を解除するという、段階的な戦闘終結への道筋が模索されていることが複数の関係筋の話で分かった。

一方、イラン政府高官は２５日、米国がホルムズ海峡の再開に向けたイランの提案を受け入れたとしても、核開発計画を巡っては一切の柔軟な姿勢を示さないとの考えを明らかにした。

３月２６日撮影　REUTERS/Kacper Pempel

[ブリュッセル ２５日 ロイター] -  欧州連合（ＥＵ）欧州委員会のヨルゲンセン委員（エネルギー・住宅担当）は２５日、イランを巡る戦闘による原油・天然ガス市場の混乱を受け、ＥＵはエネルギー価格を巡る危機に直面しているとの認識を示し、加盟国に対しエネルギー需要抑制策の検討を促した。

ヨルゲンセン氏はＥＵ加盟国のエネルギー相宛ての書簡で「われわれは供給危機に起因する価格危機に直面している」と指摘。ロシアが欧州向けの天然ガス供給を削減した２０２１年の冬よりは十分な備えができているとしながらも、各国は今冬に向け準備を一段と強化する必要があるとした。

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝円急伸、日米財務相が円安是正姿勢示す　ドル広範に下落 9/26 4:20 配信

2026年9月23日、ベセント米財務長官。 REUTERS/Nathan Howard

［ニューヨーク　２５日　ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、円がドルに対して急伸した。日米財務相が電話会談を行い、強い円が望ましいとの認識で一致したと表明したことを受けた。ドルは原油価格が２％を超えて下落したことを受け、４日続伸に歯止めがかかる方向にある。ただ、利上げ観測の高まりを背景に、週間では２週連続の上昇に向かっている。

円は１．０６％高の１５７．１３円をつけ、４日続落に歯止めをかける方向となった。９月７日以来最大の上昇率となる見通し。

日本の財務省は、片山さつき財務相とベセント米財務長官が日本時間の２５日夜、電話で会談したと発表した。両氏は円の過小評価が懸念事項であることを改めて確認。金融市場の動向等に関して意見交換を行い、両国間の協力をさらに強化していくことも再確認したという。

それでも円は週間では２週連続の下落に向かっている。市場が先週の日銀による利上げと最新のガイダンスをタカ派色が不十分と判断したためだ。

主要通貨に対するドルの価値を測るドル指数は０．３％安の１００．９５となった。

ユーロは０．１５％高の１．１３９６ドル。

ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、１０月会合での連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の利上げ確率は約６６％と、１週間前の約５８％から上昇した。

米コネティカット州スタンフォードのマネーコープでトレーディング・仕組み商品責任者を務めるユージン・エプスタイン氏は「ここ数日でドルはかなり急激に上昇しており、やや行き過ぎているのかもしれない。少し一服しているだけだ。きょうドルが実質的に大きく下落しているとは言えない」と述べた。

英ポンドは０．２３％高の１．３２４６ドル。イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）のベイリー総裁のタカ派的発言に支えられた。ただ、２４日に付けた３カ月ぶり安値近辺にとどまった。

Anthropic investor Lonsdale says AI firms stoking fear to sway policy

FAST

AUSTIN, Sept 25 : Joe Lonsdale, an investor in Anthropic and the co-founder of technology company Palantir, said on Friday that efforts by some leading artificial intelligence companies to warn of existential risks from AI amounted to a dangerous attempt to shape public policy.  Lonsdale, also founder of venture capital firm 8VC, criticized what he described as efforts by people close to Anthropic and at OpenAI to fund outside groups advocating stronger AI regulation, which he argued could help a small number of leading companies shape the rules governing the industry and entrench their market power.  "I think that what OpenAI and Anthropic are pushing right now is very dangerous, and we don't want an oligopoly that controls all of our policy here with the government," Lonsdale said at the Reuters Momentum AI Austin event.  "Safety is a real thing, but fear and regulation — we've got to be really careful how we respond to those things."

Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Elon Musk, who heads SpaceX, have all this month called for leading AI companies to slow the pace of development of their most advanced models, warning that increasingly powerful systems could pose existential risks to humanity if safeguards fail to keep pace. Lonsdale, 44, tempered his criticism with praise for Amodei and Anthropic, in which he is a small investor, saying the company had assembled exceptional talent and emerged as a leader in the AI race. "It's very hard for anyone to second-guess the highest-performing company in the world over the last few years," Lonsdale said. "I'm proud to be an investor in Anthropic." POTENTIAL UKRAINIAN DEALS Lonsdale, who has backed defense technology firms including Anduril, said some of these companies will likely buy some Ukrainian defense companies.  Ukrainian drone and defense technology firms had made rapid advances by continuously adapting battlefield systems during Russia's more than four year war, he said, adding that he sees opportunities for deeper partnerships and potential acquisitions.  "We're partnering very closely with them. A lot of our companies work with their companies," Lonsdale said. "A lot of our companies are likely to buy some of the companies over there." AUTONOMOUS WEAPONS AND DEFENSE Lonsdale said that while AI-powered autonomous weapons are the future of warfare, accountability must remain with military leaders. The issue has taken on greater urgency in Ukraine, where drones and increasingly automated systems are central to combat. It was also highlighted in the US-Iran war early this year, when a strike on a girls' school in Minab, Iran, killed more than 175 children and teachers, according to Iranian officials. Reuters reported that a preliminary US military investigation found US forces were likely responsible, and pointed to outdated intelligence used in the targeting process. "There's always a person responsible who is in charge of whatever system they studied, worked on and approved," Lonsdale said. "It's very easy from the outside to judge these things when you're not there in the fog of war." PENTAGON SHAKEUP Lonsdale has been mentioned in recent months as a potential candidate for a senior Pentagon leadership role. Asked whether he would serve if asked, he said his priority was his family and businesses.  "Obviously, if a President calls you and asks something of you, you should consider it. But my focus right now is on building my businesses and my community."  The Pentagon has faced significant leadership turmoil recently, with several high-profile departures among its senior ranks. Reuters reported this month that the White House had reviewed potential replacements for Deputy Defense Secretary Steve Feinberg.

Source: Reuters

欧州市場サマリー（25日） 9/26 3:47 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

反発して取引を終えた。銀行や鉱業株が買われた。ＦＴＳＥ１００種は週間で０．３４％高。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は前日比０．４４％高、週間では０．２３％上昇した。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種銀行株指数は１．２６％高。銀行大手のバークレイズは１．６％、ロイズは１．７％、スタンダード・チャータードは２．５％いずれも上昇した。

金価格などの値上がりを受けて、貴金属株指数は１．９５％高。

原油先物価格の上昇が一服し、石油大手のシェルは０．８％、ＢＰは２．３％それぞれ下落した。

９月の英消費者信頼感指数は約２年ぶりの水準まで改善し、市場予想を上回った。家計に対する楽観的な見方が強まり、経済の底堅さを示唆した。

イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）のベイリー総裁は、エネルギー価格の高止まりが長引けば、政策金利を据え置くことが難しくなるとの見方を示した。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

３日ぶりに反発して取引を終えた。原油先物価格の上昇が一服し、相場を下支えした。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数は週間では０．５０％高と、４週ぶりに上昇した。ただ、中東情勢や利回り上昇への警戒感も見られた。

関係者によると、イランがホルムズ海峡を開放し、米国が対イラン経済封鎖を解除するという、段階的な戦闘終結の道筋が米イラン間で模索されているという。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種石油・ガス株指数は前日比１．２５％安。一方、旅行・娯楽関連株指数は０．８２％高。欧州格安航空大手ライアンエアは２．３％、ドイツの航空大手ルフトハンザは０．８％それぞれ上昇した。

銀行株指数は１．２６％、金融サービス株指数は１．０７％、それぞれ上昇。スイスの金融大手ＵＢＳは３．５％高だった。

産業機器を手がけるフィンランドのコネクレーンズは７．４％高。業績目標の引き上げなどを発表し、買われた。ＵＢＳが投資判断を引き上げた資源大手グレンコアは２．２％上昇した。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

域内国債利回りが７週連続の上昇となる見通しとなった。エネルギー価格の上昇や中央銀行のタカ派的な姿勢を受け、利上げ期待が高まっている。

この日の原油価格は小幅に下落。市場は、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派がサウジアラビアを攻撃する中、米国とイランの停戦の可能性を見極めようとしている。

ユーロ圏の指標金利であるドイツの１０年債利回りは１．７ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の３．６２４９％と、２００９年６月以来の高水準付近で推移した。週間では約１１ｂｐの上昇となる見込み。

欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の政策金利見通しに敏感な独２年債利回りは横ばいの３．２８６８％。一時、２３年９月以来の高水準となる３．３２６９％を付けた。

今週、フランスとイタリアの国債相場は異なる動きを見せ、フランス国債は依然として圧力にさらされる一方、イタリア国債は小幅な回復を見せた。

独仏１０年債利回り格差は１０９ｂｐ。一時、１２年６月以来の高水準となる１１４．０６ｂｐを付けた。週間では４週連続拡大となる見通し。

独伊１０年債利回り格差は３月以来の大きさとなる９９．９０ｂｐを付けた後、ほぼ横ばいで推移。直近では９０．７５ｂｐとなった。

金融市場は、ＥＣＢが年内に２５ｂｐの利上げを１回実施し、さらにもう１回追加利上げに踏み切る可能性があるとの見方を織り込んでいる。また、政策金利は２７年終盤までに現行の２．５０％から３．４４％に達すると予想している。

item.title: 利回り上昇はインフレ懸念が要因でない＝米クリーブランド連銀総裁
item.description: [２５日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は２５日、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の２％目標を長年にわ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
利回り上昇はインフレ懸念が要因でない＝米クリーブランド連銀総裁 9/26 3:35 配信

2025年11月6日、米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁。 REUTERS/Brendan McDermid/File Photo

[２５日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は２５日、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の２％目標を長年にわたって上回っているインフレにより、物価上昇圧力が目標に戻るとの信認を失うのではないかとの懸念を強めていると述べた。一方で、国債利回りの急上昇はインフレ懸念が押し上げているのではないとの見方も示した。

ハマック氏はクリーブランド連銀主催のイベントで、インフレが５年超にわたって目標を上回っている状況を踏まえ「現時点でインフレに関して見られる最大のリスクは、インフレを前提とした思考様式が定着し始める可能性だ」と発言。ＦＲＢが果たすべき役割があるとし「物価を目標水準まで押し下げるため、金融政策が抑制的なスタンスにあることを確実にする必要がある」と述べた。

また、設備投資がしばらくインフレ圧力となり得るとしたほか、需要関連の物価上昇圧力にも警戒感を示した。

一方、急上昇している国債利回りについては、インフレ懸念によって押し上げられているわけではないとの見方を示した。国債利回りの急伸に関し「インフレ期待よりも実質金利がより大きく上昇した」と指摘した。その上で、米国の財政運営は持続不可能な軌道にあるとの見方も示した。

その上で「インフレ期待の観点からは、相応にしっかりとアンカー（安定）されている」と述べ、利回りの上昇は堅調な経済見通しや、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連分野への旺盛な投資に伴う投資資金の競合、市場参加者が金融政策の見通しに対応して価格を調整していることを反映しているとの認識を示した。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：米景気拡大維持、ＦＲＢの利下げペース次第 アングル：米長期金利5％接近で株式市場に警戒感、決算後はマクロ要因に注目 焦点：ベセント氏発言で強まる日銀9月利上げ観測、米国の影響力拡大に懸念も アングル：米国債「ツイスト・スティープ化」、ＦＲＢの信認巡る懸念反映か アングル：インフレで揺らぐ債券のヘッジ機能、米投資家は実物資産に移行 最終更新: 9/26(土) 4:53 ロイター

item.title: プーチン氏、ロシアの国益見極めへ ウクライナ和平案「全て選択肢」
item.description: [モスクワ ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ　２５日　ロイター] - ロシアのプーチン大統領は２５日、ウクライナ和平案は全て選択肢として残っていると述べると同時に、ロシアにとって何が最善の利益になるのか見極める必要があるとの考えを示した。

プーチン氏はロシア第２の都市サンクトペテルブルクで記者団に対し、ロシア下院選（１８─２０日実施）後にウクライナとの交渉を再開する用意があったものの、ウクライナがロシアの投票所などへの攻撃を行ったと主張。挑発的な攻撃を行ったのはウクライナで、代償としてロシアによる継続的な報復攻撃を受けることになると述べた。

その上で、ウクライナは自ら状況を悪化させているとし、「ロシアの報復攻撃を身をもって感じ、挑発行為は通用しないことを理解すべきだ」と指摘。ウクライナとの和平案は「全てが選択肢として残っている」としながらも、「ウクライナが行ってきたことを踏まえると、どう対応すべきか慎重に考えなければならない」と語った。

このほか、米首都ワシントンで２４日に行われたトランプ米大統領と中国の習近平国家主席との会談に言及し、米中間で「前向きな性格の合意」が成立するなら、ロシアとして歓迎すると述べた。中国で開催されるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議への自身の出席については、ロシア国内の情勢次第になるとの考えを示した。

プーチン氏の発言は国営テレビで放映された。

FAST

Sept 25 : Meta Platforms is adding a clearer safety warning within Muse after a security researcher discovered a vulnerability in the AI agent that could let an attacker access a user's sensitive personal information, the Information reported on Friday. The flaw, reported by an outside researcher through Meta's bug bounty program and not previously disclosed, could have allowed an attacker to access a user's dedicated virtual machine — an individualized cloud-based account containing data including emails and files, according to an internal Meta incident report reviewed by The Information. The vulnerability was initially classified as a "SEV-2," Meta's third-highest severity level on a five-point scale, typically used for incidents with significant impact, the report said. Meta did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Muse, launched earlier this month, is Meta's personal AI agent designed to carry out tasks such as shopping, travel booking, emailing and payments on behalf of users. Muse has rapidly climbed Apple's App Store and Google Play rankings in recent weeks, topping the free-app charts in the United States and Canada, with market intelligence firm Sensor Tower estimating about 2.8 million downloads in its first two weeks.

Source: Reuters

Trump says Treasury's Bessent will not be his AI czar

FAST

WASHINGTON, Sept 25 : Scott Bessent will not be Donald Trump's AI czar, the Republican president said on Friday, adding that he wants his US Treasury secretary to remain in his current role.  "Scott Bessent will not be going to be Super Intelligence (SI) Czar. Number One, he doesn’t want to. Number Two, he’s doing such a great job at Treasury, and that’s where I want to keep him! Why would I ever make such a change?" Trump said in a social media post, using his preferred term for artificial intelligence.  Last week, Trump said he plans to appoint an artificial intelligence adviser, known as an "AI czar," and create an "AI force," though he gave no details about either initiative or how they would be implemented.  Some had seen Bessent as a front runner for the role. Last Sunday, he had led talks heavily focused on AI with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng in New York, ahead of this week's summit between Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington.

Bessent told reporters after the talks that the US side had proposed an AI safety notification mechanism and bilateral dialogue on the issue, with a particular emphasis on national security concerns.  The White House did not immediately provide details on who might be tapped for its AI czar.  Trump has repeatedly downplayed concerns about AI and argued that additional regulation is unnecessary even as fears grow among lawmakers in Washington and globally about risks posed by the technology.  Top AI researchers have warned that people building AI believe it could kill humans within a decade, following cases of AI agents going rogue to hack external systems. Several Democratic and Republican lawmakers have responded with alarm and calls for more action.

item.title: トランプ氏、ベセント財務長官のＡＩ責任者起用を否定
item.description: [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン　２５日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２５日、人工知能（ＡＩ）分野を担当する新組織「ＡＩフォース」の責任者にベセント財務長官を起用しない方針を示した。

トランプ氏は「ベセント氏がスーパーインテリジェンス（ＳＩ）ツァーに就任することはない。本人もそれを望んでおらず、財務省で素晴らしい仕事をしている。その職にとどまってほしい」と自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に投稿した。

トランプ氏は１９日、「ＡＩフォース」を創設し、米政府のＡＩ政策を統括する「ＡＩツァー（ＡＩ皇帝）」を任命すると表明。ホワイトハウスは政府のＡＩ政策責任者に誰が起用される可能性があるか、現時点で明らかにしていない。

item.title: ロシアでの拘束、周到な「おとり捜査」 米ＷＳＪ記者が著書で見解
item.description:
Mark Trevelyan
[ロンドン ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Mark Trevelyan

[ロンドン　２５日　ロイター] - ２０２３年にロシアで拘束後、スパイ罪に問われ収監されていた米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）のエバン・ゲルシコビッチ記者が、一連の経緯を詳細に記した著書で、自身の拘束がロシア連邦保安庁（ＦＳＢ）による周到な「おとり捜査」によるものだったとの見解を示した。ＷＳＪが２５日、著書の抜粋を報じた。

ゲルシコビッチ記者は、ロシアの軍需生産を巡り、防衛産業の拠点エカテリンブルクの工場の労働組合関係者に２回、対面で取材した。２度目にレストランで会った際、戦車の生産に関するものだとする手書きの書類を見せられ、メモを取っていると、近づいてきた覆面の男らに拘束されたという。

ゲルシコビッチ記者や編集者らは事前に取材のリスクを検討。情報提供者が書類を持ち込まないようにすることや、持ち込まれた場合にも受け取らないことを決めていた。ただ、２回目の対面取材では「書類が手に押し付けられた」とし、これらの２回の対面取材は、ＦＳＢがロシアのプーチン大統領に対し、スパイだと説得し、拘束する承認を得るためだったとの見方を示した。

プーチン氏は２４年２月、米テレビのインタビューで、ゲルシコビッチ記者が機密情報を収集している最中に現行犯逮捕されたとの認識を示していた。

ゲルシコビッチ記者は懲役１６年の判決を受けたが、２４年８月の囚人交換で釈放された。記者やＷＳＪ、米政府は、いずれも記者がスパイだったことを否定している。

item.title: Alcaraz helps Team Europe take 3-1 Laver Cup lead over Team World
item.description: Team Europe took a 3-1 lead over defending champions Team World on the opening day of the Laver Cup on Friday, with Carlos Alcaraz and Jakub Mensik closing out the night with a straight sets doubles victory at The O2.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Team Europe took a 3-1 lead over defending champions Team World on the opening day of the Laver Cup on Friday, with Carlos Alcaraz and Jakub Mensik closing out the night with a straight sets doubles victory at The O2. World No. 3 Alcaraz, competing in his second tournament after the US Open following a four-month injury layoff, joined Mensik to beat Alexander Bublik and Taylor Fritz 6-4 6-4. The Spaniard and Czech, who also partnered at last year's Laver Cup in San Francisco, fended off three early break points before Alcaraz found his range and fired an overhead smash to secure the first break. They broke again early in the second set and held firm from there, with Mensik serving out the match, with Alcaraz sealing victory at the net. "I'm just trying to have fun in every place that I go and on every court that I play on," Alcaraz said. "I don't usually play doubles ... I just try to enjoy and be better at things. I use doubles to try and improve my tennis, a couple of adjustments. Having a partner like Jakub, it's really easy to have fun on the court." The victory gave Europe three points from Friday's four matches, after Norwegian Casper Ruud got them off to a winning start by edging Francisco Cerundolo 6-7(4) 6-4 10-8. Brandon Nakashima levelled the contest for Team World by beating Mensik 6-1 3-6 10-7, before Rafael Jodar restored Europe's lead with a commanding 6-2 6-3 victory over Alexander Bublik in the Spaniard's Laver Cup debut. Jodar, who was watched from the stands by Roger Federer and John McEnroe, said he was thrilled to have the tennis greats at his first appearance in the competition. "It's a pleasure that they are in the stands watching me," Jodar said. "It's a pleasure to see them watching these types of matches." OPENING STRIKES Earlier on Friday, Ruud and Cerundolo were locked in a tight opening set, with neither player able to break before the Argentine edged the tiebreak 7-4. Ruud responded by breaking for a 5-4 lead in the second set which he claimed before forcing the match tiebreak, where the Norwegian held his nerve after the players traded points until 8-8. "I have to thank my team and my bench. They pushed me all the way. They kept me in it, really ... Europe can build on this," Ruud said. Nakashima then produced a composed performance on his Laver Cup debut, racing to a 5-0 lead against Mensik before the Czech fought back to take the second set, leaving the American to wrap up victory in the match tiebreak. "This guy... I'm not convinced he's real. I think he's AI," Team World captain Andre Agassi said, praising Nakashima's ability to stay calm under pressure. "He just goes about his business point after point after point." The three-day Laver Cup pits six players from Europe against six from the rest of the world, with victories worth one point on Friday, two on Saturday and three on Sunday. The first team to reach 13 points wins the title.

FAST

Sept 25 : A jury in Santa Fe, New Mexico, found on Friday that Meta Platforms misled the state's residents in a case arising from allegations that a political consulting firm involved in Donald Trump's 2016 presidential campaign obtained data from millions of Facebook users without their consent. The verdict followed a two-week trial over a lawsuit filed by New Mexico’s attorney general in 2021, three years after news reports revealed that the firm, Cambridge Analytica, had harvested personal data from as many as 87 million Facebook users through a third-party app. A Meta spokesperson said the company disagreed with the verdict and would continue to defend itself "against efforts to distort our record." "Meta's platforms are forums for free expression," the spokesperson said. "We have a First Amendment right to manage those platforms in a way we believe best serves the interests of our community. This means prioritizing free speech, protecting our users' information and giving them control over their data."

At a press conference after the verdict was announced, New Mexico Attorney General Raúl Torrez said the case revealed "in stark detail the way in which this company plays fast and loose with the rules." The state accused Meta of misleading New Mexicans about how it shared user data with third parties and enforced policies on hate speech and misinformation. New Mexico argued that Facebook failed to disclose that it sold user data to outside parties and allowed harmful content to spread when doing so benefited the company's bottom line. Jurors found 26 of 29 statements identified by the state were misleading, including comments about user data, hate speech and misinformation. They rejected claims that Meta misled consumers in statements about its efforts to remove harmful content and its fact-checking practices. MAXIMUM PENALTY SOUGHT Judge Francis Mathew will now determine civil penalties after jurors found more than 43 million violations, based on the number of people affected by the company's misleading statements. Under New Mexico law, Mathew can award up to $5,000 per violation. Torrez said his office is evaluating how much to seek but will push for the maximum penalty based on the jury's findings. The state will also ask Mathew to direct Meta to make changes, which could include corrections to its past misstatements as well as an audit of the way it manages user data, Torrez said. MISLEADING CLAIMS DETAILED The state's lawsuit focused on specific statements, including comments made by Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg or in company blog posts, that New Mexico said made people believe they had control over the personal information they shared on the site, or that the site had blanket policies for how it dealt with hate speech or misinformation. Meta was selling the data to third-party apps, like the one that Cambridge Analytica relied on, and had exceptions to its policies for certain users, the state said. Attorneys for Meta had argued at trial that the allegedly misleading statements were cherry-picked snippets that ignored critical context from the same statements, in which the company had repeatedly acknowledged its handling of misinformation or privacy issues was not perfect.  Meta also denied that it sells users' information. Reuters viewed the trial on Courtroom View Network.  EARLIER NEW MEXICO CASE The verdict marks the second time in six months a jury in Santa Fe has weighed a lawsuit brought by the state of New Mexico against Meta Platforms. In the first trial, which ended in March, a Santa Fe jury found Meta misled users about young users’ safety on its Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp platforms and ordered the company to pay $375 million in civil penalties. After a second phase of that trial, a judge directed the company to pay $567 million into a New Mexico fund for teen mental health and ordered Meta to implement measures to protect teen Facebook and Instagram users in New Mexico. A few weeks after the judge’s ruling, Meta reached a sweeping settlement with 47 US states, Washington, D.C., and US territories, agreeing to pay a maximum of about $16.7 billion to resolve claims that it designed Facebook and Instagram to addict young children. As part of that deal, it agreed to pay a handful of states that had sued the company over privacy violations related to Cambridge Analytica $459 million to resolve those cases. New Mexico was not part of the settlement, so its case over Cambridge Analytica moved forward to trial.

Source: Reuters

FTC chair suggests AI developers should be liable for conduct of agents

FAST

AUSTIN, Sept 25 : US Federal Trade Commission Chairman Andrew Ferguson said on Friday he would resist describing AI agents as autonomous actors that "break loose" with "wills and desires of their own," suggesting the developers who instruct agents would be the ones liable for harm. "I'm going to continue as long as I am chairman to resist this anthropomorphizing of these tools," Ferguson said at the Reuters Momentum AI Austin event. "If someone tells a tool to do something, and the tool does it, I don't think we would say, 'Oh, what do we do about the tool?'" Ferguson's remarks illustrated potential avenues for the Trump administration to take as incidents rise in which agentic AI testing resulted in unauthorized access to corporate or government data. Artificial intelligence companies have sometimes described systems as acting beyond human control, but subsequent reviews of audit trails have shown that the systems were carrying out instructions they had been given, Ferguson said.

Recent incidents involving AI agents accessing external systems have prompted governments and industry leaders to examine whether existing oversight and cybersecurity measures are sufficient. The US should utilize existing legal tools, Ferguson said. He suggested that FTC authority to take action against companies that fail to disclose data breaches could also apply to AI developers. PERSONALIZED PRICING CONCERNS  The FTC is gearing up to request data from consumer-facing companies on their use of personalized pricing, Ferguson said, referring to businesses using consumers' individual data, such as location and internet browsing history, to set prices. The practice has drawn criticism from state and federal lawmakers concerned with bolstering affordability in the US. Ferguson said last month that the FTC would not hesitate to enforce the law in this area, particularly where companies are not disclosing the practice. The FTC has already initiated enforcement actions on personalized pricing disclosures, he said.  "We are in the process of trying to get a market study that will actually get to the heart of the question, which is, are particular merchants in particular markets that have access to tremendous amounts of data using that data to charge differentiated prices to different people," he said.  As an individual, he said he is most concerned about use of the practice by delivery and rideshare apps, along with airlines. Airlines faced criticism last year after a Delta Air Lines executive suggested AI tools were being used to gauge customers' willingness to pay. Delta has since said that it does not personalize prices based on individuals' data, and an American Airlines executive has said doing so would hurt customer trust.  Earlier this year, a US congressional committee demanded information from Uber, Instacart and others on whether they use customer data to set prices. Both companies said at the time that they do not use personal information to set prices.  The FTC would request information from companies in order to publish a study on the practice. Ferguson's predecessor, Lina Khan, initiated a similar study into the practice, which she referred to as surveillance pricing. That study focused on companies that offer data and consulting services on pricing, rather than merchants themselves. AD FRAUD CRACKDOWN The FTC on Thursday called for public input on a potential rule that would disincentivize tech companies like Meta Platforms and Alphabet's Google from allowing fraudulent or misleading ads. Meta projected 10 per cent of its 2024 revenue would come from ads for scams and banned goods, Reuters reported last year.  The FTC has ongoing law enforcement actions related to fraudulent ads, Ferguson said. Those investigations convinced him of the need for rule-setting requirements for online platforms to mitigate fraud. "We need to make the rules hyper clear for everyone involved in this market," he said.

Source: Reuters

Solidigm held pitch meetings this week with investment banks competing for roles on

FAST

NEW YORK, Sept 25 : Chipmaker SK Hynix's Solidigm is considering an initial public offering as early as next year that could value the US subsidiary at up to $150 billion, according to three people familiar with the matter. Solidigm held pitch meetings this week with investment banks competing for roles on the IPO, in a process known as a "bake-off," one of the people and a fourth person said, marking a concrete step toward what could become the largest-ever US semiconductor listing. The company could raise $15 billion in the IPO, the three people said, speaking on condition of anonymity to discuss confidential matters. The plans, including the size of deal and timing, remain at an early stage and could change depending on market conditions, they added. The listing would rank as one of the largest semiconductor IPOs on record and could provide a standalone valuation for a business that has become a key part of SK Hynix's storage portfolio. It would also seek to tap strong investor demand for companies tied to artificial intelligence infrastructure, which has fuelled gains in semiconductor and hardware stocks.

Solidigm, based in Rancho Cordova, California, is the US-based NAND flash memory and solid-state drive (SSD) subsidiary of South Korea's SK Hynix Inc. Solidigm declined to comment. SK Hynix said in a statement: "Solidigm is reviewing various options to strengthen its business competitiveness, but no specific plans have been confirmed at this time." BOOSTING COMPETITIVENESS SK Hynix acquired Intel Corp's NAND memory and SSD business for about $9 billion in a deal announced in 2020, combining those operations with Solidigm, which was launched as a standalone subsidiary in 2021. At the time, the company said the acquisition would strengthen its NAND flash and enterprise SSD businesses and expand its position in the global memory market. Solidigm supplies enterprise SSDs used in servers, cloud infrastructure and data centers. The company has sought to differentiate itself through high-capacity storage products designed for AI applications, where growing volumes of data require increasingly sophisticated storage solutions. Reuters reported earlier this month that Solidigm is considering building a NAND flash memory chip factory in the US, with upstate New York emerging as a leading candidate, as part of efforts to expand manufacturing capacity. Last month, SK Hynix said it was considering measures to boost Solidigm's competitiveness after media reports that the unit was exploring a pre-IPO fundraising round of about 5 trillion won ($3.6 billion). A valuation of up to $150 billion would far exceed recent semiconductor IPOs, including Arm Holdings' roughly $54 billion valuation at its 2023 debut and Cerebras Systems' approximately $56 billion fully diluted valuation in its 2026 IPO.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Iran will make no nuclear concessions, Iranian official says
item.description: The official said the Strait of Hormuz would remain closed until “all of Iran’s conditions are met.”
item.dc:creator: Parisa Hafezi, Don Durfee
item.content:encoded: Iran will show no flexibility over its nuclear program even if the United States accepts its proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, which calls for steps including the lifting of a US naval blockade on Iranian ports, a senior Iranian official told Reuters on Friday. The official, speaking on condition of anonymity, said the waterway would remain closed until “all of Iran’s conditions are met” by the United States. Under [USN:L6N45H06Z TEXT:"Iran’s proposal"], Tehran has offered to reopen the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz. Within seven days, hostilities would end on all fronts, including Lebanon, the United States would lift its blockade on Iranian ports, release Iran’s frozen funds and waive its oil sanctions, Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi said on Thursday. The proposal follows a sharp escalation in Middle East tensions after seven months of war between Iran and the United States, with Iran-backed Houthi militias in Yemen launching missiles and drones at Saudi Arabia. The strait has become the central bargaining chip in efforts to end the US-Iran conflict, with Iran seeking relief from the US blockade that is choking its economy and Washington seeking free passage for ships on the global oil supply route now blocked by Tehran. In a meeting with journalists on Thursday on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly , Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said he hoped a deal with Washington to end the hostilities could be reached before the US midterm elections on November 3. Tehran said it would be prepared to engage in detailed negotiations over its nuclear program only after its conditions are met by the US. But the official said Iran would give no concessions over its rights, including enriching uranium or shipping its highly enriched uranium out of the country, one of the main US demands. Israel, the United States and other Western states have long accused Iran of seeking nuclear weapons, including pointing to its move to enrich uranium to 60%, far higher than needed for civilian uses and closer to the 90% needed for a weapon. Iran denies seeking nuclear weapons. The International Atomic Energy Agency estimates that Iran had 440.9 kg of uranium enriched to 60% when Israel and the US attacked Iranian nuclear facilities in June 2025. How much of that has survived is unclear. Iranian authorities have said that Iran could agree to dilute its most highly enriched uranium. In May, Reuters reported that Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei has issued a directive that the country's HEU should not be sent abroad, according to two senior Iranian sources.

FAST

CAIRO: Saudi , Turkish and Pakistani military chiefs are to discuss help for Saudi Arabia as it faces attacks by Yemen's Houthis , while Iraq further curtailed Iranian flights on Friday (Sep 25), in line with US pressure, and an Iranian official threatened retaliation. The Houthis have launched strikes on the Saudi -backed government in Yemen and repeatedly fired into Saudi Arabia , disrupting oil flows from the world's largest energy exporter, as part of a wider Middle East war that began with US and Israeli strikes on Iran on Feb 28. The military escalation continued this week despite a push during the UN General Assembly in New York to revive diplomacy to end the conflict, which quickly spread to Lebanon and the Gulf in March before escalating in Yemen in recent weeks. With talks stalled and during a lull in direct fire by the US and Iran, Washington had shifted tactics to extend financial sanctions by targeting companies from third countries that do business with Iranian firms through "secondary sanctions".

Iranian airlines were barred from neighbouring countries including the Unite d Arab Emirates and Oman on Thursday in response to new US sanctions , the first big impact of the shift. On Friday, the three other Iraqi airports that operate flights to and from Iran joined Baghdad airport in suspending them, sources and state media said. A flight ban, if sustained, could deepen Iran's isolation and worsen an economic crisis in the country, which is already facing a US blockade of its seaports. Mohammad Mokhber, an adviser to Iran's supreme leader, accused regional countries of "alignment with America" for blocking flights . "If Iran does not have the possibility to fly and receive airport services, then no country in the region will have this possibility either", he said in a social media post.

OIL EXPORTS SQUEEZED The war, which US President Donald Trump launched alongside Israel, has killed thousands of people and disrupted global trade and energy supplies, adding to inflationary pressures. While the fighting between the US and Iran has been stop-start, Iranian allies have mobilised, with Hezbollah attacks triggering an Israeli invasion of Lebanon and the Houthi advance in Yemen prompting a new humanitarian crisis. Iran and its allies have significantly squeezed oil exports from Saudi Arabia , a US ally. The Houthis have disrupted ship traffic at the mouth of the Red Sea, while Iran has limited tanker traffic at the Strait of Hormuz, the conduit for 20 per cent of the world's oil exports before the war. On Thursday, the Houthis said they had fired dozens of missiles and drones at Saudi targets, while Saudi authorities said they had intercepted six ballistic missiles fired by Houthi fighters. Later, Saudi Arabia 's Grand Mufti, the kingdom's top religious authority, called on soldiers to be ready to lay down their lives to fight the Houthis until the group was ousted from power. Amid the fighting, the Saudi , Pakistani and Turkish foreign ministers met on Thursday for discussions under a defence pact signed in August . They condemned attacks targeting the holy Saudi city of Mecca and other civilian sites, while affirming Saudi Arabia 's right to defend itself and planning a meeting between chiefs of staff on ways to assist the kingdom. Turkey's defence ministry said Chief of General Staff General Selcuk Bayraktaroglu was travelling to Saudi Arabia on Friday to meet his Saudi and Pakistani counterparts. Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan said the defence pact, which stipulates that an attack against one country be considered an attack against all, could lead to intelligence, logistical or ammunition support. " More advanced military support could also be considered depending on the scale of the threat," Erdogan said in written responses to Newsweek. The speaker of Turkey's parliament, which has yet to ratify the pact, said it could be expanded into a broader alliance "for the Muslim world" , including Iran.

Related:

US 'must choose' whether to end war: Iran president to Fox News

Saudi civil defence issues brief danger warning for Mecca city

SHUTTLE DIPLOMACY IN NEW YORK In New York, Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi told reporters on Thursday that Tehran had conveyed a proposal to the US via intermediaries under which the Strait of Hormuz would be reopened if Tehran’s conditions were met. Under Iran’s proposal, hostilities would end on all fronts, including Lebanon, within seven days. The US would lift its blockade on Iranian ports, release Iran’s frozen funds and waive its oil sanctions, he said. "The Strait of Hormuz will be reopened on the last day," Araqchi said, adding that talks with the US on other issues, including Iran’s nuclear issue, would then start. A senior Iranian official told Reuters on Wednesday that Tehran was reviewing Washington's response to its peace proposals. Oil prices fell on Friday as markets weighed the possibility of a truce, despite the number of ships recorded transiting the Strait of Hormuz dropping to nine on Thursday, half the 10-day average.

Source: Reuters/fs

item.title: 米中首脳、親密な関係強調 年内あと2回の会談に意欲
item.description: [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領と中国の習近平国家主席は２５日、ホワイトハウスで茶会に臨んだ後、米国立公文書館を訪問し、３日間にわたる首脳会談を締めくくった。経済関係などを巡る大きな進展よりも、親密な関係をアピールする首脳外交の色彩が際立った。また、両首脳とも年内にあと２回会談する可能性を示唆した。

両首脳は、メラニア夫人、彭麗媛夫人とともにホワイトハウスの応接室「レッドルーム」での茶会に出席し、互いを称賛した。トランプ大統領は、世界二大経済大国による今回の首脳会談で「大きな進展」があったとした上で、「米国は今回の訪問を大いに歓迎しており、中国側も同様だと確信している」と述べた。

さらに、「米農家も喜ぶだろう」と語ったが、詳細には踏み込まなかった。

また、両国は今後も「頻繁に話し合うことになるだろう」との認識を示した。

習氏は、両国関係が「相互尊重、公平、互恵に基づく戦略的安定」という建設的な関係へ発展したと述べ、米中関係をより実りあるものにしていくことでトランプ大統領と一致したと語った。

さらに、今年終盤に中国・深圳で開かれるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議と、米マイアミで開催される２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）首脳会議に合わせ、トランプ大統領と年内にあと２回会談する機会があるとの見方を示した。

トランプ大統領も、これら首脳会議に合わせ、１１月に中国、１２月に米国で再び会談する見通しだと述べた。また、今回の会談は「成功」だったとし、これからも多くのことが成し遂げられるとの期待を表明した。

両首脳はその後、国立公文書館を訪れ、米独立宣言や合衆国憲法、権利章典など、米国の歴史を象徴する文書を見学したもよう。

中国側は公文書館訪問についてコメントしていないが、アナリストらは、習氏が１９７９年の米中国交正常化や、台湾との断交に関連する記録に関心を示している可能性があると指摘していた。

中国側の発表によると、習氏は２４日の会談で台湾問題を取り上げた。中国国営通信の新華社によると、習氏は「米国が台湾問題を慎重に扱い、中米間の戦略的協力と両国関係の発展に向けた強固な基盤を築くことを望む」とトランプ氏に伝えた。また新華社の英語版は、習氏が米国に「台湾独立に反対する」ことを望んだとも報じた。

また、イラン情勢に関する記者団の質問に対し、トランプ大統領は習氏と協議したことを明らかにした上で、詳細には触れず、「うまくいくと思う」と述べるにとどめた。

item.title: マイクロソフト、「コパイロット」刷新 ＡＩ機能拡充でライバルに対抗
item.description:
Deborah Mary Sophia
[２５日 ロイター] - 米ＩＴ大手マイクロソフトは２５日、人工知能（ＡＩ）ア...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
マイクロソフト、「コパイロット」刷新　ＡＩ機能拡充でライバルに対抗 9/26 0:33 配信

７月２０日撮影　REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Deborah Mary Sophia

[２５日　ロイター] - 米ＩＴ大手マイクロソフトは２５日、人工知能（ＡＩ）アシスタント「コパイロット」の刷新を発表した。常時稼働する自律型ＡＩエージェントといった新機能を導入。米オープンＡＩの生成ＡＩ「チャットＧＰＴ」やアンソロピックの「クロード」との競争が激しくなる中、ＡＩ機能の拡充によりライバルに対抗する狙い。

「Ｏｆｆｉｃｅ（オフィス）」アプリのＷｏｒｄ、Ｅｘｃｅｌ、ＰｏｗｅｒＰｏｉｎｔが「コパイロット」に統合され、利用者は「コパイロット」を使いながら、アプリで共同作業ができるようになる。

マイクロソフトの幹部は「セキュリティーや法令順守、企業統治上の懸念から、エージェント導入が困難だった企業が多い」とし「実際に活用できるよう取り組んだ」と述べた。

自然言語で指示を出すとアプリなどのソフトウエアを構築できる「Ｃｏｄｅ」は、ＧｉｔＨｕｂ（ギットハブ）コパイロットと同じ技術を採用している。一部の利用者には今月内に提供を開始し、年内に対象者を拡大する。

今年６月に発表したＡＩエージェント「スカウト」を刷新した「Ａｕｔｏｐｉｌｏｔ」は、９月末に早期利用が可能な一部の顧客向けに公開する。

item.title: Gen Z is betting on AI skills to boost earning power
item.description: As AI reshapes entry-level work, young workers are using the technology to boost productivity, build portfolios and pursue new careers.
item.dc:creator: Hani Richter
item.content:encoded: Mariana Antaya, a 25-year-old former product manager at Microsoft. Courtesy Ivan Mrsic Creative Studio/Handout via REUTERS Mariana Antaya, a 25-year-old former product manager at Microsoft, says that being AI literate is one of the most important skills to leverage for her earning power. “The number of things and tasks that I can do, and the speed that I can do it at, ultimately increases and raises the way that I can create value to other people, to shareholders,” says the New York-based entrepreneur, whose fintech startup quantifAI helps users build and test trustworthy machine learning models. Antaya learned the basics of AI at university, where she studied mathematics and computer science. She started utilizing large language models like ChatGPT as soon as they came out, using it to predict Formula 1 races or forecast which team would win the Premier League. Antaya’s biggest use case, however, was for coding. After graduating in 2023, Antaya applied for dozens of jobs in the tech industry — including management, software engineering, and design roles — before landing an internship at Microsoft, where she worked on voice features and later built evaluation frameworks and tools for AI voice models. Now, she develops AI-focused products and shares how she created them online with her followers — skills that she says carry more value than credentials alone. “If you have an actual receipt of what you built and you're able to publish it online, other people are able to see it as useful proof,” she says. “That goes way further than any sort of little badge.” Antaya now uses AI to schedule tasks, draft replies to every single email in her inbox, analyze large volumes of data or gather webinar analytics from Zoom. Knowing how to use the technology will make you indispensable, she says. “That's what I did. And it has honestly led me to so many more opportunities than I could have ever imagined.” The Wider Trend Compared to older generations, young people tend to be more excited about the impact AI will have on their careers. A 2025 PwC survey of more than 2,000 young workers across the UK found that 67% of Gen Z expect AI to increase their productivity, while nearly half expect it to increase their salary and job security. Mariana Antaya, a 25-year-old former product manager at Microsoft. Courtesy Ivan Mrsic Creative Studio/Handout via REUTERS Matthew Chancey, a certified financial planner and founder of Tax Alpha Companies, says free AI training can offer significant value. “Material that used to sit behind a tuition wall is now free, often published by the companies building the tools,” he says. When evaluating a course, Chancey recommends checking who created it, whether it’s current and, crucially, whether it results in a finished project rather than just a quiz. For those who decide to pay for training, Chancey recommends checking first whether your employer will cover the cost, noting that many employers offer these benefits, though workers seldom take advantage of them. Key Takeaways Invest time before spending money. AI upskilling can be a long-term career investment, with time often proving more valuable than tuition fees. Check whether your employer offers training support or educational benefits. Prioritize projects over certificates. Hands-on projects that improve workflows can carry more weight with employers. Turn higher earnings into long-term security. If AI helps boost your income, consider saving or investing the extra earnings before increasing your spending. Building an emergency fund, paying down debt, and contributing towards retirement can strengthen your financial position over time. Have a money lesson or story to share? Tell us what worked for you — or what didn’t — by emailing hani.richter@tr.com .

US appeals court upholds Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic

FAST

NEW YORK, Sept 25 :  A federal appeals court upheld on Friday the Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic from military contracts, handing a victory to President Donald Trump and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth in their battle with the AI startup over safety guardrails on its technology. The 2-1 decision by the US Court of Appeals in Washington, D.C. came in a lawsuit by Anthropic challenging its March designation by the Pentagon as a national security supply chain risk, which the startup says has cost it billions of dollars in lost business and damaged its reputation ahead of a highly anticipated initial public offering.  The court's majority said it was reasonable for the Pentagon to designate Anthropic after it refused to allow its products to be used for autonomous weapons or mass surveillance. It rejected Anthropic's claim that the Pentagon had retaliated against it for its views on AI safety and ethics. Siding with Hegseth's argument that Anthropic's safety restrictions could compromise military operations, the majority said: “The Secretary raises the deeply sobering prospect of overly constrained AI models shutting down unexpectedly and thus causing important military operations to fail," in an opinion by Judge Gregory Katsas.

San Francisco-based Anthropic said in a statement Friday that it respectfully disagrees with the decision but remains confident in its position and is considering its options, including review of the three-judge panel's decision by the full appeals court.  The White House and the Department of Defense did not immediately respond to emails seeking comment.  A federal judge in San Francisco last month struck down a parallel designation under a different law, finding the administration had unlawfully retaliated against Anthropic for its views on AI safety. US District Judge Rita Lin in San Francisco also blocked Trump's government-wide ban on Anthropic and Hegseth's order barring military contractors from doing any business with the startup. Hegseth designated Anthropic as a risk under two different laws after Anthropic refused to remove guardrails against its technology being used for autonomous weapons or mass domestic surveillance. The unprecedented move came after months of negotiations ended in failure and public recriminations by Hegseth and Trump, who accused Anthropic of endangering American lives with ideological posturing.  Anthropic denied that characterization and said AI is not yet reliable enough to be safely used in autonomous weapons. The company also said it opposes domestic surveillance as a violation of fundamental rights.

Source: Reuters

item.title: ＡＩエコシステムの「大きすぎてつぶせない」リスク、ＦＲＢ把握すべき＝カンザスシティー連銀総裁
item.description:
Howard Schneider
[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米カンザスシティー地区連銀のシュミッド総裁は...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＩエコシステムの「大きすぎてつぶせない」リスク、ＦＲＢ把握すべき＝カンザスシティー連銀総裁 9/26 0:08 配信

2023年6月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

Howard Schneider

[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米カンザスシティー地区連銀のシュミッド総裁は２５日、人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームに伴い、業界で形成されつつある企業や契約のネットワークが「大きすぎてつぶせない（too big to fail）」問題に発展していないかを米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が把握することが重要との認識を示した。

シュミッド総裁は、「ＡＩやデータセンターの構築を巡って何が起きているのかを真に包括的に理解するため、まず考えなければならないのは、『大きすぎてつぶせない』ＡＩエコシステムへ移行しつつあるのかどうかだ」と述べた。２００７─０９年の金融危機の際、主要金融機関がその規模と実体経済への影響力ゆえに公的救済を必要とした事態に言及した発言だ。

その上で「システム的なリスクは存在するのか」との問題を提起した。

item.description: [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米ミシガン大学が２５日発表した９月の消費者信頼感指数の確報値は４８．１と、８月の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ミシガン大消費者信頼感9月確報は48.1、4カ月ぶり低水準  9/25 23:59 配信

2026年8月26日、米国ニューヨーク市で撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米ミシガン大学が２５日発表した９月の消費者信頼感指数の確報値は４８．１と、８月の５１．７から低下し、４カ月ぶりの低水準となった。インフレ加速が家計の購買力を損なうとの懸念が背景にある。ただ、速報値の４７．８からは改善した。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は４７．６だった。同指数は１月から１５％低下している。現在および今後１年間の家計に対する見方はいずれも約１０％悪化し、高インフレへの懸念が引き続き強まった。消費者調査ディレクターのジョアン・スー氏は「全体として、年初来で経済見通しが悪化したという点で、政治的立場を超えた幅広い一致が調査から浮かび上がった」と指摘。「今月は特に大きく信頼感が落ち込んだ結果、共和党支持層の信頼感は２０２６年１月と比べ２０％低い水準にある。民主党支持層も同期間に１３％低下した」と述べた。１年後のインフレ期待は４．６％と、８月の４．０％から上昇した。イランとの紛争が始まる前の２月時点の３．４％から急上昇している。５年後のインフレ期待は３．４％と、小幅に上昇した。前月までは３カ月連続で３．３％を維持していた。

item.title: 米中貿易交渉の詳細、28日公表 ＵＳＴＲ代表「進展あった」
item.description: [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - グリア米通商代表部（ＵＳＴＲ）代表は２５日、中国との貿易交渉の結果に関する詳細を２８日に公表する見通しだと明らかにした。

グリア代表はＣＮＢＣとのインタビューで、「われわれは管理貿易の状況にある。進展はあった。ここ数週間の対中交渉で達成した内容について、２８日により詳細な情報を公表する予定だ」と述べた。

トランプ大統領は２４日、中国の習近平国家主席とホワイトハウスで首脳会談を行ったが、多くの懸案事項について具体的な打開策が示された兆候は限定的だった。

グリア代表は、米中が貿易摩擦の対象から一部の主要品目を除外することで合意したと述べた。米国からの農産物や医療機器の輸出、中国からの消費財や機密性の低い品目の輸入に言及し、「将来的に貿易紛争や関税措置が発生しても、これらの品目は対象外となる」と述べた。

一方、輸出にライセンスが必要な少量の高性能な米国製半導体については協議の対象となっていないと説明。「これらは米国技術の至宝であり、超知能や人工知能（ＡＩ）の開発競争で米国が優位を維持するための手段だ。だからこそ、これらに関する対話は今回の交渉では実際には行われていない」と語った。

ベセント財務長官は２３日、１１月１０日に期限を迎える米中間の「貿易休戦」について、両国が２カ月間延長することで合意したと明らかにした。より包括的な貿易協定に向けた協議の時間を確保することが目的としている。

item.title: ローマ教皇、国際対話は「茶番」を化す恐れ 国連は実効性の危機に直面と警告
item.description:
Joshua McElwee Elizabeth Pineau
[パリ ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Joshua McElwee　Elizabeth Pineau

[パリ　２５日　ロイター] - ローマ教皇レオ１４世は２５日、国連や他の多国間組織が危機に直面していると述べ、国際対話が「茶番」と化す恐れがあると警告した。国連教育科学文化機関（ユネスコ）のパリ本部で行った演説で語った。

教皇はこの日、４日間の日程でフランス入りした。演説では、特定の個人名を挙げることなく、法の支配を軽視する世界の指導者らを非難し、「権力者は、法を尊重する代わりに、自らの利益にかなう時にだけ法を持ち出し、自分たちの行動を制約する時には無視する。正義そのものをまるで売買するための商品のように扱っている」と述べた。

さらに、国連や他の多国間組織は「実効性の危機に直面している」とし、「対話は、平和のための資源ではなく行動の障害と見なされ、共に公益を追求する機会ではなく、茶番として扱われている」と語った。

２０２５年５月に初の米国出身教皇として就任したレオ１４世は、今年に入り、イラン戦争を批判してトランプ米大統領の怒りを買った。

FAST

WASHINGTON, Sept 25 : Kansas City Fed President Jeff Schmid said that as the artificial intelligence boom unfolds it will be important for the Fed to understand if the network of firms and contracts developing in the industry is becoming so large it is too big to fail. "Where we have to start to really synthesize what's happening in the AI and the data center build-out is are we moving to a too-big-to-fail AI ecosystem," he said, referring to the need for public bailouts of major financial institutions during the 2007 to 2009 financial crisis because of their size and influence on the broader economy. "You worry a little bit about how do we understand what's inside. ... Is there anything systemic?" he asked.

Source: Reuters
