item.title: Man City found guilty on all but one of 115 charges, reports say, with appeal expected
item.description: Manchester City have been found guilty of all but one of the 115 alleged breaches of the Premier League's financial rules, The Athletic reported on Friday, a potentially seismic development in a case that has hung over English football for years.
item.dc:creator: Lori Ewing
item.content:encoded: Manchester City have been found guilty of all but one of the 115 alleged breaches of the Premier League's financial rules, The Athletic reported on Friday, a potentially seismic development in a case that has hung over English football for years. The club are expected to appeal, indicating that the process was not yet complete. They have always denied any wrongdoing. "The Premier League process remains ongoing, with significant elements to be completed, and subject to strict confidentiality," the club said in a statement to British media. "As such Manchester City FC's position remains consistent with the club's statement of February 2023. "The club has diligently respected due process for eight years on the basis the Premier League board and executive would behave as an independent, impartial and fair minded regulator, free from partisan influence." The Premier League declined to comment. "It’s a confidential process, we’re not commenting at all," a spokesperson said. A guilty verdict would represent one of the most significant rulings in English football history in a case that has overshadowed the league for more than three years. The proceedings have raised questions about financial regulation, competitive integrity and how the league enforces its rules against its most successful clubs. ALLEGATIONS SPANNING MORE THAN A DECADE The Premier League referred City to an independent commission in February 2023 over [USN:L4N34M29T TEXT:"alleged breaches"] of financial rules spanning the 2009-10 to 2022-23 seasons. The club have consistently denied wrongdoing. Among the most serious allegations was that City failed in each season from 2009-10 to 2017-18 to provide accurate financial information giving a "true and fair view" of revenues, including sponsorship income, and operating costs. City hired lawyer David Pannick to lead their defence, while the Premier League was represented by Adam Lewis, according to British media reports. The hearing began on September 16, 2024, and concluded nearly three months later on December 6. The case was heard by an independent commission composed of three people appointed by the independent chair of the Premier League Judicial Panel. Former City midfielder Rodri said on Friday he had always trusted the club's insistence that it had done nothing wrong and said the players had shared that belief throughout the case. "Hopefully, justice can be done, whatever happens obviously, but I trust in the impunity of that club which I know very well. And they always transmitted their confidence that they’d done everything correctly," he told a press conference on the eve of Spain's Nations League game against England at Wembley. "Until the moment they’re proved wrong, we will believe the club and I've been there and I know how they work and how they cooperate," said the midfielder who now plays for Barcelona. European soccer's governing body UEFA banned City from the Champions League for two years by in 2020 after finding the club had overstated sponsorship revenue between 2012 and 2016. City, however, successfully appealed to the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS), which overturned the ban. Since Sheikh Mansour’s Abu Dhabi United Group bought the club in 2008, City have won eight Premier League titles, the Champions League, four FA Cups and seven League Cups. City currently top the Premier League after winning each of their opening five matches. Rodri believes nothing can diminish City's achievements. "What we did, they cannot take out of us. It's something that is not paid by money, it's paid with effort, with partnership, with being shoulder to shoulder every day," he said. "We had a lot of successful years and here in Wembley, so I can only tell you that everything was deserved and I'm glad I could live one of the best eras of English football in here," he added referring to City's Cup triumphs at the stadium. HIGH STAKES The stakes are particularly high because other clubs have already faced sporting sanctions for breaching financial regulations. Everton were docked a total of eight points during the 2023-24 season after two separate breaches of the Premier League's Profitability and Sustainability Rules, while Nottingham Forest were deducted four points for a breach of the same rules in March 2024. Newcastle United narrowly avoided potential sanctions after selling players before a June 30, 2024, financial reporting deadline to comply with spending regulations. The allegations against City are far broader and cover more than a decade, making the case unprecedented in scale. Lawyers, club executives and supporters across the league have spent years awaiting a verdict. Ian Hargreaves, partner at specialist disputes firm Quillon Law, said the "rumoured verdict is not the end of the story but the beginning of a new phase in what has become one of the most closely watched legal battles in global sport." The key questions raised, he said, are what sanctions the panel considers proportionate and what guidance can be drawn from previous cases. "There is a wide range of options, with a transfer ban at the more moderate end of the spectrum and expulsion from the league the most severe repercussion," Hargreaves said. "There is also the question of whether the panel’s decision can withstand a hard-fought appeal, and on what grounds any challenge might be brought. Much will depend on the detail of the panel’s findings and reasoning, which will inevitably be closely scrutinised by both sides." Responding to the reports, Caroline Dinenage, chair of Britain's Culture, Media and Sport select committee, urged that due process be followed while calling for the case to be concluded as quickly as possible. "The reports ... have profound implications for our national game," Dinenage said in a statement. “The extraordinary length and cost of this process raise serious concerns, and the affair again gives rise to questions about financial fairness across the football pyramid. “The matter must be allowed to take its course and due process must be followed, but I sincerely hope any further stages are completed as swiftly as is reasonably possible.”

item.title: トランプ氏、対加通商交渉に満足 「急ぐ理由ない」＝ＵＳＴＲ代表
item.description:
David Shepardson
[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
David Shepardson

[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - グリア米通商代表部（ＵＳＴＲ）代表は２５日、ＣＮＢＣに対し、対カナダ通商交渉について、トランプ大統領は現状に満足していると述べた。来週にはカナダ製品を対象とした新たな米輸入禁止措置が発効し、米政府は来年１月からカナダ製の自動車、部品、鉄鋼に５０％の関税を課すと警告しているが、トランプ政権はカナダとの通商対立を維持することに問題はなく、米国側に急ぐ理由はないとした。

この発言は、米政府が譲歩の必要をほとんど感じていないことを示している。

米国が近く導入する輸入禁止措置は、アルコール飲料、オートバイ、乳製品を含む幅広いカナダ製品が対象。１月の関税５０％への引き上げは、北米の自動車生産に重大な影響を及ぼす可能性がある。

一方、カナダによる米製品への報復関税は今月に入って発効した。

グリア代表は「石油、ガス、カリ肥料など、必要なものは依然としてカナダから得られている。農産物も国境を越えて相互に出荷しており、両国間には引き続き活発な貿易がある」と述べた。その上で「われわれは現状に満足している。カナダは時折こちらに連絡してきて、合意の可能性について良好な対話を行っているが、米国側に急ぐ理由はないと言える」と語った。

在ワシントンのカナダ大使館は現時点でコメントしていない。

一部の専門家は、トランプ政権がまずメキシコとの合意を目指しているとみている。これによりカナダとより有利な合意を結ぶための交渉力が高まる可能性があるためという。メキシコ当局者は今週、メキシコとの次回交渉が１０月に行われる可能性があると述べた。

item.title: 再送「強い円が望ましいとの認識で一致」、日米財務相が電話会談
item.description:
(見出しを修正します)
［東京 ２５日 ロイター］ - 日本の財務省は、片山さつき財務相とベセント米財務長官が日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
再送「強い円が望ましいとの認識で一致」、日米財務相が電話会談 9/25 23:08 配信

2026年8月3日、片山さつき財務相。REUTERS/Issei Kato/File Photo

(見出しを修正します)

［東京　２５日　ロイター］ - 日本の財務省は、片山さつき財務相とベセント米財務長官が日本時間の２５日夜、電話で会談したと発表した。同省の声明によると、両氏は円の過小評価が懸念事項であることを改めて確認。金融市場の動向等に関して意見交換を行い、両国間の協力をさらに強化していくことも再確認したという。

一方、ベセント長官もＸへの投稿で、片山財務相との電話会談は有意義なものだったと表明。日本の力強い経済のファンダメンタルズを反映した強い円が望ましいことや、為替市場について緊密な意思疎通を続けることの重要性を協議したと述べた。

また、今回の電話会談は、今週行われたトランプ大統領と高市首相の協議を踏まえたもので、日米パートナーシップの強固さを反映するものだったと説明した。

これを受け、外国為替市場では円がドルに対して上げ幅を拡大。円は対ドルで１．０９％高の１ドル＝１５７．１３円と、４日続落に終止符を打ち、１日としては９月７日以来最大の上昇率となる見通しとなった。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：主要国債利回りが軒並み歴史的高水準、債務持続性巡る不安と利上げ圧力で コラム：ベセント発言過信の危うさ、円相場の現在地を考える＝唐鎌大輔氏 コラム：米財務長官の「リフレ政策をやめろ」発言をどう受け取るか＝熊野英生氏 コラム：日銀利上げの「美しいシナリオ」に弱点はないか＝上野泰也氏 アングル：「どう暮らせばいいのか」生活苦深まるイラン市民、指導部は抗議再燃を警戒 最終更新: 9/26(土) 0:44 ロイター

France's prestigious Goncourt prize drops novel after author accused of using AI

PARIS, Sept 25 : The organisers of the prestigious Goncourt literary prize said on Friday they had removed a smash-hit novel by Haitian-Canadian author Thelyson Orelien from their longlist after accusations he used AI to write it. Orelien denied using AI to write "C'etait Ca ou Mourir" ("It Was Either That or Die") as the allegations ignited a debate about race, literary merit and originality that has roiled the French literary establishment. The accusations about AI use were made this week by a little-known X account "Balance ton Claude." Essayist Samuel Fitoussi later claimed ownership of the account, saying he managed it with other unidentified individuals. The AI accusations were followed by reports that Orelien had committed plagiarism in earlier works. La Presse said that a 2012 short story by Orelien had plagiarized passages from a book by French author Louis Pauwels, while a 2013 opinion piece copied from The Philippine Star newspaper.

Orelien has yet to respond to those accusations, and did not respond to a request for comment on Friday. The Paris-based Academie Goncourt said it had taken note of the AI and plagiarism accusations, and had decided to remove his novel "to preserve the integrity of the Goncourt Prize and that of the Academie, whose central role is to promote and honour literature written by women and men." The Academie said it hoped its decision would show it was fully against the "creation of texts generated with the assistance of AI," adding it would make no further comment before October 6, when it will announce its shortlist. The debut novel by the Haitian-born author tells the story of a Haitian migrant who travels north through Latin America before ending up in Canada. It has won a host of other literary awards, and was due to be translated into multiple languages. His French and Canadian publishers initially offered Orelien their full support over the AI allegations. They did not respond to requests for comment on Friday. "Balance ton Claude" said that running passages through AI detection tool Pangram showed the novel "was written almost entirely by artificial intelligence". Some experts say the reliability of AI detection tools is questionable.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米ＴＶ各社がホワイトハウス取材再開、習氏訪問で 締め出し巡る訴訟続く
item.description: [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米テレビ各社は２５日、トランプ大統領のホワイトハウスでの行事の取材を再開し、中国の習近平国家主席の訪問について初めて代表取材（プール取材）による生中継が可能となった。一方、米ＣＮＮ、ＭＳ
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン　２５日　ロイター] - 米テレビ各社は２５日、トランプ大統領のホワイトハウスでの行事の取材を再開し、中国の習近平国家主席の訪問について初めて代表取材（プール取材）による生中継が可能となった。一方、米ＣＮＮ、ＭＳ ＮＯＷ、ポリティコに対する取材制限を巡っては、依然として法廷闘争が続いている。

トランプ氏は先週、虚偽または否定的だと主張する報道を理由にこの３社をホワイトハウスから締め出した。３社は政権を提訴し、連邦地裁は締め出しが違憲の可能性が高いとしてアクセスを直ちに回復するよう命令。３社のアクセスは２４日に復活した。

ホワイトハウスのテレビ代表取材は、習氏が訪米最終日の２５日にお茶のためホワイトハウスに到着する様子や、両首脳が米国憲法を収蔵する国立公文書館を視察する様子を映像で伝えた。

ＣＮＮ、ＡＢＣ、ＣＢＳ、ＦＯＸニュース、ＮＢＣの５大ネットワークは大統領取材の費用を分担し、輪番で取材してプール映像を他社に提供している。連帯を示すため他ネットワークがカメラ設置を拒否したことで、習氏訪問の最初の２日間はプール取材が行われなかった。

ＣＮＮは２５日夕、トランプ氏の週末のテネシー州訪問に際し、大統領専用機エアフォースワンへの同乗を拒否されたと明らかにした。ホワイトハウスはロイターのコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。

２５日に習氏のホワイトハウス到着に合わせてプール取材が再開された際、トランプ氏は中国やイラン、自身のメディア排除、そして税金で賄われた自身の大統領職を宣伝する物議を醸す新たなテレビ広告に関する記者団の質問への回答を拒んだ。その後、記者団に謝意を示し、習氏の隣で「公平な報道に感謝する。非常に公平だった。感謝している」と述べた。

ホワイトハウスは、取材アクセス回復に関するコメント要請に応じなかった。

item.description: BANGKOK, Sept 25 : Thailand's economy is expected to retain its momentum and grow by 2.5 per cent next year and could reach 3 per cent expansion within the next three years, the finance minister said on Friday, as the government pushes for new investments into key sectors. Ekniti Nitithanprapas told Reuter

FAST

BANGKOK, Sept 25 : Thailand's economy is expected to retain its momentum and grow by 2.5 per cent next year and could reach 3 per cent expansion within the next three years, the finance minister said on Friday, as the government pushes for new investments into key sectors.   Ekniti Nitithanprapas told Reuters he was confident of achieving 2.5 per cent economic expansion in 2027, in what was his first growth projection for next year. Top of the government's agenda, he said, was to court more foreign and domestic investment, including in niche semiconductor segments.  "In my opinion, growth might be likely to be higher than what maybe the Bank of Thailand or other people forecasted," he said in an interview two weeks out from the annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank, taking place in Bangkok.

"We need to keep pushing domestic investment to grow further and reduce reliance on export sectors."  Last week, assistant central bank governor Don Nakornthab told Reuters the bank was maintaining its growth forecasts of 2.3 per cent for this year and 1.8 per cent for 2027. He put potential growth at 2.7 per cent and said it could take four to five years to return to that rate. INFLATION AND BAHT VOLATILITY Southeast Asia's second-largest economy expanded 1.9 per cent year-on-year in the second quarter, down sharply from 2.8 per cent growth in the previous quarter. The economy, which grew 2.4 per cent last year, has been struggling with weak productivity, subdued demand, high household debt and low investment. Ekniti said he was not concerned about inflation, which should stay within 3 per cent this year and next, while the weaker baht might be better for the Thai economy but should not be volatile. The baht has weakened by 5.6 per cent against the US dollar so far this year.  Headline inflation accelerated to 2.53 per cent in August but within the central bank's 1 per cent to 3 per cent target range.   The government's consumer subsidy scheme, which has been in operation for four months, would account for 0.4 per cent to 0.5 per cent of GDP growth in 2026, Ekniti said. The scheme was this week extended through to November, with 43 billion baht ($1.29 billion) allocated, part of a broader 400 billion baht borrowing programme.  "We target to give subsidies to help people affected by the rising cost of living. So that's why we expect it to be short-term," said Ekniti, who is also deputy prime minister.  "We plan to lower it down, and we're trying to push investments going forward." NICHE SEMICONDUCTORS Thailand is targeting $80 billion in semiconductor investment by 2050 and more than 230,000 new jobs under a national strategy announced on Thursday, which aims to build a fully integrated domestic chip ecosystem and generate $150 billion in annual revenue. "We are quite good in photonics. We are quite good in sensing and power units. So we aim to move in that direction," he said. "We will provide lots of incentives, work with private sector so that we can bring in more investment." Ekniti said the government was also working with the central bank to try to boost credit access to small businesses. The public debt-to-GDP ratio would rise to 68 per cent to 69 per cent this year, he added, but still under the 70 per cent ceiling.  A positive factor for Thailand was its political stability, he said. "Never before have we had good coalition parties with only two parties," he said. "That could provide stability for the government to continue credible policies."  ($1 = 33.3200 baht)

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米コア資本財受注、8月は1.6％増と予想上回る ＡＩ投資が下支え
item.description: [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米商務省が２５日発表した８月の耐久財受注は、民間設備投資の先行指標とされるコア資本...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米コア資本財受注、8月は1.6％増と予想上回る　ＡＩ投資が下支え 9/25 22:40 配信

米カリフォルニア州バレンシアのパシフィック・ロック工場で錠前を製造する従業員。２０２５年１２月撮影。REUTERS/Aude Guerrucci

[ワシントン　２５日　ロイター] - 米商務省が２５日発表した８月の耐久財受注は、民間設備投資の先行指標とされるコア資本財（非国防資本財から航空機を除く）の受注が前月比１．６％増加した。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想（０．５％増）を上回る伸びとなり、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連インフラの構築を背景に、企業の設備投資が今四半期も堅調に拡大していることを示唆した。

７月は０．６％増と、速報値の変わらずから上方改定された。

８月は前年同月比では１０．６％増加した。

項目別の受注は、電気機器・家電・部品が１．１％増と伸びを主導した。コンピューター・関連製品は１．５％急増し、前年同月比では２０．１％増となった。通信機器は０．３％増、前年同月比では３５．８％急増した。

機械は１．１％、一次金属は１．２％それぞれ増加。一方、金属加工品は１．３％減少した。

自動車・部品は０．６％減。民間航空機は４．３％減となった。米航空機大手ボーイングのウェブサイトによると、８月の航空機受注数は１５機。７月は３８機だった。

非国防資本財の受注は１．２％増加した。

耐久財受注全体は７月の０．９％増から８月は横ばいとなった。輸送機器の受注が０．６％減少したことが重しとなった。耐久財受注はトースターから航空機まで３年以上使われるモノを指す。

８月のコア資本財の出荷は０．６％増。７月は１．４％増だった。

非国防資本財の出荷は１．３％減となった。

企業の設備投資は、ＡＩ関連の積極的な投資に支えられ２四半期連続で２桁の伸びを記録しており、製造業および経済全体を下支えしている。ただエコノミストらは、原油価格や金利、米長期債利回りの上昇を背景に、特にＡＩと関連の薄い分野の製造業が減速する可能性があると警鐘を鳴らしている。

ＦＷＤＢＯＮＤＳのチーフエコノミスト、クリストファー・ラプキー氏は「ＡＩ投資ブームは本物であり、経済全体をけん引している」と指摘。その上で「唯一のリスクは、いずれ全ての設備投資とデータセンターの建設が完了し、このＡＩバブルが膨張し切った後の成長要因が不透明であることだ。投資支出は成長の加速要因と見なされているが、いずれ終わりは必ず来る」と述べた。

item.title: トランプ氏「習主席と非常に実りある会談」、詳細は明らかにせず
item.description: [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン　２５日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２５日、中国の習近平国家主席と「非常に実りある会談」を行ったとし、「素晴らしいことが起きるだろう」と自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に投稿した。ただ、詳細については明らかにしなかった。

トランプ氏は２４日、習氏とホワイトハウスで会談。豪華な国賓待遇で習氏を迎え、儀礼的な演出は盛大だったものの具体的な成果は乏しく、人工知能（ＡＩ）、貿易、台湾、イラン情勢といった懸案事項について具体的な進展は確認されなかった。

STOCKHOLM, Sept 25 : An expected European Union vote on allowing Tesla's supervised Full Self-Driving system across the bloc has been delayed from October, with the next apparent opportunity for a decision not before December, according to an agenda published on the EU's website. • Dutch regulator RDW approved the system in April, with Belgium and a handful of other countries following suit • RDW is also proposing that the software be approved across the bloc • Tesla said on September 1 in a post on X that an EU-wide vote could potentially happen on October 6

• However, the agenda for an October 6 meeting of the Technical Committee on Motor Vehicles (TCMV), which brings together representatives of EU member states and the European Commission, lists only a "continuation of discussions" on the Dutch request for an Article 39 authorisation, with 25 minutes allocated to the discussion • RDW told Reuters it would not speculate on the discussion, the vote or any potential outcome. • Tesla did not respond to a request for comment. In response to a post on X about the delayed vote, CEO Elon Musk wrote: "sigh" • The committee has already discussed Tesla's request at two previous meetings. The next scheduled TCMV meeting after October is in December, making that the earliest apparent opportunity for a vote based on the current agenda • An EU-wide rollout requires support by a "qualified majority" of 15 of the EU's 27 member states, representing 65 per cent of the bloc's population • Several EU countries, including Sweden, have expressed concerns about FSD exceeding speed limits, while countries that approved it say drivers remain responsible for complying with traffic laws • The same committee approved Ford's BlueCruise driver assistance system March 2024, with Germany as its sponsor • Tesla has called FSD approval key to boosting sales in Europe, where it is seeking to regain market share amid growing competition from Chinese electric-vehicle makers

Source: Reuters

item.title: Trump warns Xi over Chinese support for Iran, receives assurances, US envoy says
item.description: China assured the US it would not provide support, the US ambassador to China said.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Susan Heavey, Katharine Jackson, Parisa Hafezi
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump warned Chinese President Xi Jinping against providing support to Iran during talks in Washington this week and received assurances that China would not do so, the US ambassador to China said on Friday. The warning came amid reports that China had supplied Iran with shoulder-fired air-defense missile launchers and that Tehran had found ways to evade sanctions on its oil sales with Chinese help. David Perdue, Trump's ambassador to Beijing, said in a CNBC interview that Trump reiterated to Xi that direct or indirect support for Iran was "totally unacceptable." Asked separately on Fox News if that meant China would stop assisting Iran, Perdue said Washington received assurances from Beijing on Thursday. "We've seen movement ... on that already. That's what the commitment is. They assured us yesterday they're not doing that," Perdue told Fox News' "America's Newsroom" program. Trump later on Friday acknowledged that the two leaders discussed the war that the US and Israel launched on Iran in late February, without giving details. MISSILE LAUNCHERS, SANCTIONS DODGE US lawmakers had [USN:L1N45F0ZP TEXT:"urged Trump to confront Xi"] over reports of Chinese assistance to Iran, raising concerns that Chinese entities may have given [USN:L8N45A1LM TEXT:"targeting help"] that led to US casualties in the conflict. Chinese officials have assured Iran that even after the Trump-Xi meeting China will not limit its economic, political or military ties with Tehran under pressure from the US president, a senior Iranian official told Reuters on Friday. Reuters reported in July that Iran was expected to receive within weeks a first shipment out of up to 400 Chinese-made [USN:L8N43P1IL TEXT:"shoulder-fired air-defense missile launchers"]. Iran has also used a [USN:L6N43P11D TEXT:"barter-like arrangement to bypass sanctions"] on its oil sales and buy billions of dollars’ worth of goods from China, including military gear, two senior Iranian sources and three other people familiar with the matter told Reuters earlier this month. Chinese state newswire Xinhua reported on Thursday that Xi had urged the US and Iran to return to negotiations to end the war, but Xi has not publicly commented on Chinese support for Iran. Trump and Xi did not take formal questions during the three-day state visit to Washington. Earlier this month, Trump [USN:L8N4550G3 TEXT:"brushed aside"] a report that Iran acquired satellite images of a base in Jordan from Chinese entities before an attack that killed three US troops there in July. "They basically do what we do," Trump told reporters aboard Air Force One on September 13. "When they say China spies on us, I say you're right and we spy on them too."

item.title: 中国はイラン支援せずと確約、トランプ氏が習主席に警告＝駐中国米大使
item.description:
Bo Erickson Susan Heavey Katharine Jackson Parisa Hafezi
［ワシントン ２５日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Bo Erickson　Susan Heavey　Katharine Jackson　Parisa Hafezi

［ワシントン　２５日　ロイター］ - トランプ米大統領は２４日に行った中国の習近平国家主席との会談で、中国によるイラン支援は容認できないと明確に伝え、習主席は支援しないと確約した。米国のパデュー駐中国大使が２５日、明らかにした。

パデュー大使はＣＮＢＣのインタビューで「数週間前、イランへのいかなる支援も、直接か間接かを問わず、情報、部品、軍事装備のいずれであっても、全く容認できないと中国側に明確に伝えた」とした上で「トランプ大統領は昨日、あらためてこの点を非常に明確にした。このメッセージは継続的に発信している」と述べた。

ＦＯＸニュースの番組で、こうした状況は中国によるイラン支援停止を意味するのかとの質問に対し、「すでに動きが見られる。中国側は２４日、支援はしないとわれわれに保証した」と応じた。

パデュー氏はまたＣＮＢＣとのインタビューで、トランプ氏と習氏について「一定の信頼関係を築き始め、諸問題に取り組んでいる」と指摘。「非常に率直で開かれた会談だった」とし、両首脳が話すたびに、取り組んでいる懸案を巡り、より踏み込んだ意思疎通ができていると感じると語った。

トランプ大統領もこの日、習主席との会談でイラン情勢について協議したと確認。ただ、詳細は明らかにしなかった。

item.title: Pope Leo warns that AI is creating 'paradise of machines'
item.description: Pope Leo says "there is an urgent need for education in ethical discernment".
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Pope Leo warns that AI is creating 'paradise of machines'

Pope Leo says "there is an urgent need for education in ethical discernment".

Pope Leo delivers a speech during a meeting with French President Emmanuel Macron and authorities, members of civil society and the diplomatic corps at the Elysee Palace in Paris as part of his four-day apostolic journey to France, on Sep 25, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Benoit Tessier/Pool)

FAST

PARIS: Pope Leo urged the world to reconsider the development of artificial intelligence , opening his four-day visit to France on Friday (Sep 25) with a fervent warning that AI could create a future where "a paradise of machines" takes control of the Earth. The first US pope, who has made sounding the alarm about the risks of AI a central part of his 16-month papacy, put the issue at the heart of his visit to France, the first by a pope in nearly 20 years. "If we are to avoid losing our humanity amid a 'paradise of machines' invading and conditioning our daily lives, there is an urgent need for education in ethical discernment," he said, speaking under the gilded ceilings of the Elysee Palace. The pope also strongly reiterated the Church's pro-life teachings, criticising initiatives to allow assisted dying for those who have incurable illnesses, two months after French politicians approved such a measure.

"I am concerned … by those trends in society that risk turning science and technology into profit-driven ventures promoting genetic manipulation, surrogacy, the trade in human organs or the possibility of arranging one’s own death," he said. The pope, on a whirlwind three-city visit to France, will also seek to repair the Church's standing there after abuse scandals sparked nationwide shock, and is also expected to lay out a vision for the future of Europe in a speech on Monday.

Pope Leo XIV walks on a red carpet toward France's President Emmanuel Macron and his wife Brigitte Macron ahead of a meeting at the Elysee Presidential Palace, in Paris on Sep 25, 2026, at the start of his four days visit to France. (Photo: Remo Casilli/POOL/AFP)

"MESSAGE OF PEACE" The pope was greeted at the Paris Orly airport, under a clear blue sky, by President Emmanuel Macron and his wife Brigitte, and by children who sang for him and asked for autographs. During his visit, he will travel to the famed Catholic shrine at Lourdes, in the southwest, and to Metz, on the German border. Pope Leo was due to lead a prayer service in Paris on Friday at the restored Notre-Dame cathedral, in the first visit by a pope since a devastating fire nearly destroyed the Gothic masterpiece in 2019. Telling reporters on the plane to Paris that he was coming to convey a message of peace, he added: "It is a message which at this time, as we all may know, is particularly important." People lining the streets Pope Leo was due to pass through on his way to the Elysee held up phones and waved flags and signs. "He brings a message of peace and hope that is very, very positive. His visit to France sends a wonderful signal to the country," a Catholic passer-by, Antoine Barxias-Casties, said in front of Notre-Dame cathedral on the eve of Pope Leo's visit. Next on the pope's agenda on Friday is a speech to staff at the headquarters of the UN culture and education body, UNESCO, which is facing budget shortfalls after US President Donald Trump withdrew from the agency in 2025. The first US pope attracted Trump's ire earlier this year after criticising the Iran war. Asked about Trump's attempt to bar CNN and several other outlets from the White House, Pope Leo, aboard the plane to Paris, reaffirmed his support for freedom of the press, saying all were welcome to cover his visit.

France's President Emmanuel Macron (L) welcomes Pope Leo XIV (R) ahead of a meeting at the Elysee Presidential Palace, in Paris on Sep 25, 2026 at the start of his four days visit to France. (Photo: Teresa Suarez/POOL/AFP)

SECULAR NATION France, a secular nation where the separation of church and state is enshrined in a 1905 law, has witnessed a steady decline in affiliation to the Catholic Church during the post-war era, mirroring a trend in other traditionally Catholic countries. Although the French Bishops' Conference points to an increase in baptisms of adults, a report published by the official statistics agency INSEE showed that only 25 per cent of French 18-to-49-year-olds identified as Catholic, compared with 43 per cent a decade earlier. Pope Leo's visit comes as Catholic leaders in France have been at odds with the government over the 2024 enshrining of a right to abortion in the French constitution, a world first, and the passage of the law legalising assisted dying for adults with incurable illnesses. POPE TO MEET ABUSE SURVIVORS Local Church leaders hope the pope's visit will repair the Church's standing after a crushing 2021 report found that some 330,000 French children had been abused by Catholic clergy and lay leaders over seven decades. French bishops have since introduced compensation and safeguarding measures, but survivors have continued to press Church leaders to demonstrate accountability. "Leo bears the immense responsibility of 'declaring enough is enough'," Alain Esquerre, 66, a spokesperson for victims at the Notre-Dame de Bétharram Catholic institution, told Reuters. The pope will meet seven French victims of abuse by Catholic clergy on Sunday in Lourdes.

Related:

Source: Reuters

FAST

Sept 25 : Microsoft on Friday unveiled several new capabilities in its Copilot app, including a coding tool and an always-on AI agent, as the software giant seeks to transform its AI assistant into a one-stop shop for office workers. The company is also embedding its Office applications Word, Excel, and PowerPoint directly within Copilot, allowing users to work collaboratively on these apps without having to leave the AI tool. Shares of the Redmond, Washington-based company rose about 3 per cent in early trading. Microsoft is racing to expand Copilot beyond its chat-based roots to boost adoption as it competes with AI chatbots such as ChatGPT and Claude.

The Windows maker unveiled "Code" to let users build apps, dashboards and other software using natural language prompts. The tool, powered by the same technology as Microsoft's GitHub Copilot, will roll out to early-access customers at the end of the month, while 365 Premium and Pro subscribers can preview it later this year. Microsoft is also rolling out "Autopilot", a revamp of the "Scout" AI agent it unveiled in June, in a private preview at the end of the month. The so-called digital coworker agent will carry its own identity in the company directory and have specific permissions that users can control. "I think it's been very hard for many organizations to bring agents into the enterprise because of security, compliance and governance concerns," Annie Pearl, corporate vice president of Copilot Product, said in an interview. "So we've worked... to make sure that we were building this in a way that would really be able to be used in the enterprise." Microsoft also unveiled cost-management capabilities to allow employees to have direct insight into costs tied to their AI usage. The move comes at a time when enterprises are increasingly worried about rapid AI usage racking up unexpected costs.

item.title: ウクライナ財政・国防支援、ＥＵ・ＩＭＦも重要性理解＝大統領
item.description: [キーウ ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[キーウ ２５日 ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は２５日、欧州連合（ＥＵ）と国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）が、ウクライナの財政赤字を補い、国防費を賄うための支援の重要性を理解していると述べた。

ゼレンスキー氏は、１０月と１１月に無人機（ドローン）を発注する必要があり、できなければ来年初めに困難な状況に直面すると語った。

メッセージアプリ「ワッツアップ」を通じた記者会見で「ウクライナだけでは対応できず、ウクライナ製のドローンやミサイルへの投資を増やす必要があることを誰もが理解している」と述べた。ＥＵのフォンデアライエン欧州委員長から前向きな回答を得たとも明らかにした。

ウクライナは国防費だけでなく、社会保障費や人道支援に関する支出も海外からの支援に頼っている。来年は５２０億ドルを超える国際的な資金支援が必要になると見込んでいる。

マルチェンコ財務相は記者団に対し、ウクライナ向け融資プログラムの第２次審査を行うＩＭＦ調査団が１１月に訪問する見通しだと述べた。それまでに来年の予算の財源確保に向けた計画を策定する必要があるとした。

item.title: メッカ防衛協定、イラン参加も可能＝トルコ国会議長
item.description: [アンカラ ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[アンカラ ２５日 ロイター] - トルコのクルトゥルムシュ国会議長は２５日、トルコ、サウジアラビア、パキスタンが合意した「メッカ共同防衛協定」について、イランも含む「イスラム世界のための」より広範な協定に発展する可能性があると述べた。

アンカラで記者団に「国際協定の発効には国会の承認が必要だ。現在行われている協定関連の会合は準備段階のものだ」と説明した。国会が１０月に休会明けを迎えることに触れ、「近く審議される見込みだ」と述べた。

協定がイランに対抗するものかとの質問に対し、特定の国を標的としたものではないとするトルコの立場を改めて示した。紛争やイスラエルの「敵対的政策」が続く中、地域諸国の安全確保を主眼に置いたものだと説明した。

「メッカ協定をイランに対抗する協定とは全く考えておらず、そうあってはならない。むしろイスラム世界のためのより広範な協定に発展することを望んでいる。イランも参加でき、他の地域諸国の参加によって協定が一層強固になることを期待している」と語った。

PARIS, Sept 25 : Crypto exchange Bitget has stopped allowing customer withdrawals following the theft of crypto worth approximately $351.6 million in a hack, it said, adding all user funds were safe. Bitget had noticed "unauthorised transfers" from some of its wallets on Thursday and it "temporarily suspended" customer withdrawals, Gracy Chen, CEO of the Seychelles-based company, said in a statement posted on X. Chen said that all user funds were safe and that the loss was covered by Bitget's own funds. "Withdrawals remain temporarily suspended as a security precaution, not because of any shortfall in funds," Chen told Reuters in an emailed statement on Friday.

Last year, crypto exchange Bybit had $1.5 billion stolen in a hack, which the FBI attributed to North Korean hackers.  North Korea routinely denies involvement in cyber hacking or crypto heists.  Authorities have said criminals can quickly move stolen cryptocurrency across borders, without using the mainstream financial system.

item.title: Rising sea destroys homes, erases beaches in California. Is worse to come?
item.description: Experts say even more ferocious waves could arrive in the coming months.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Trotta
item.content:encoded: In Malibu, the Pacific Ocean opened a sinkhole near the home of movie star Nicolas Cage and wreaked havoc on beachfront property. Along Beach Road in the city of Dana Point, waves destroyed one home and forced the city to vacate or restrict occupancy to 16 others. Such damage up and down Southern California this summer was provoked by a series of Eastern Pacific cyclones and hurricanes, enhanced by the weather phenomenon known as El Niño. Although the hurricanes did not make landfall in California, they generated swells that slammed into the coast, denuding beaches of sand and transforming a coastline that is as much a part of California's identity as Hollywood or Silicon Valley. Experts say even more ferocious waves could arrive in the coming months, when naturally occurring weather cycles, supercharged by climate change, could coincide with the highest of high tides. "Things are definitely lining up for this to be a pretty epic winter in terms of potential hazards," said Patrick Barnard, research director of the Center for Coastal Climate Resilience at the University of California, Santa Cruz. "Everything's amplified by climate change." California this week preemptively declared a state of emergency to help mobilize disaster relief and first responders in preparation for more turmoil from [USN:L1N45F06R TEXT:"El Niño,"] which emerged in June. The phenomenon is expected to demonstrate its greatest effects through year end and into early 2027. On Friday, another hurricane, Polo, churned off the Mexican Pacific coast . It could send more waves northward. Officials canceled the inaugural Ocean Way Festival set for this weekend in Santa Monica, after storm surf and runoff from Hurricane Marie over Labor Day weekend eroded much of the concert site just south of the pier. El Niño occurs every few years, when surface waters in the central and eastern tropical Pacific Ocean become unusually warm, altering atmospheric circulation and weather around the world. The Southern California sea level has risen 8 to 12 inches (20 cm to 30 cm) over the past century. A strong [USN:L6N44I0Q7 TEXT:"El Niño"] could temporarily increase the sea level another 6 to 12 inches (15 to 30 cm). KELVIN WAVE AND KING TIDES Related to El Niño is the underwater Kelvin wave, which could temporarily add another 6 to 12 inches in sea level. The first major Kelvin wave of the current El Niño is expected to reach California in early October, according to Michael Jacox, an oceanographer at the US National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration. The effects could coincide with seasonally extreme king tides occurring during the tide-amplifying phase of the 18.6-year lunar nodal cycle. El Niño could also produce massive rainstorms known as [USN:L1N3XW08X TEXT:"atmospheric rivers"] that often flood coastal areas and erode beach bluffs. California's generally steep coastline has until now largely spared residents the chronic inundation seen in low-lying coastal areas elsewhere in the world. In Carlsbad, a city of 112,000 about 35 miles (56 km) north of San Diego, the sand disappeared almost overnight from Tamarack beach, the jewel for a city that raises 14% of its operating budget from hotel room taxes. Adam Young, a coastal geomorphologist from UC San Diego's Scripps Institution of Oceanography, visited Tamarack recently, climbing over cobblestones where there used to be sandy beach. Just to the south, the ocean swallowed the beach completely, cascading into a parking lot that once allowed visitors to park just a few steps from the sand. Young said state and local government can attempt to harden properties, add sand to the beach, or form dunes out of the cobblestones, mimicking nature. "There often isn't one solution that works for everyone," Young said. "It's important to remember that erosion on the coastline has been going on for thousands of years. It's a natural process. The problem is really that we build stuff in the way and on the beaches and in these hazardous areas, and that's caused the problem." Surfers still flock to Tamarack. But a beach typically populated with tourists and locals now has only a few visitors who stake out a patch of what little sand remains. "Hopefully they can figure out a solution because honestly, I think Mother Nature is going to take everything back until they stop it, right?" said surfer Alex Stott after a morning session. "It's showing it can take the entire beach if it wants to pretty quickly."

item.title: 英企業、ウクライナ戦場データ活用へ ドローン向けＡＩ開発巡り
item.description:
[ロンドン ２５日 ロイター] - 英政府は２５日、国内の企業がドローンスウォーム（無人機の群れ）向けの新たなＡＩ（人工知能）モデルを開発するために、ウクライナからの戦場データを利用できるようになると発表した。
• バーナム英首相とゼレンスキー・ウクライナ大統領との間で結ばれた合意により、ウクライナ国内で無人航空機システムによって収集された画像や動画のデータベースへのアクセスが許可されることとなった。このデータベースには、戦車、大口径の火砲 、防空システム、歩兵、空中目標など、６００万件以上の物体検知データが含まれている。
• 英政府によると、ドローンスウォームは自律的に飛行・航行・走行し、ＡＩを活用して協調し、脅威や標的を識別し、意思決定を行う。また、こうした作戦には常に人間の関与があるとも付け加えた。

• バーナム英首相とゼレンスキー・ウクライナ大統領との間で結ばれた合意により、ウクライナ国内で無人航空機システムによって収集された画像や動画のデータベースへのアクセスが許可されることとなった。このデータベースには、戦車、大口径の火砲 、防空システム、歩兵、空中目標など、６００万件以上の物体検知データが含まれている。

• 英政府によると、ドローンスウォームは自律的に飛行・航行・走行し、ＡＩを活用して協調し、脅威や標的を識別し、意思決定を行う。また、こうした作戦には常に人間の関与があるとも付け加えた。

• ストリーティング英国防相は声明で「実戦データへのこの世界初のアクセスにより、英国企業は防衛イノベーションの最前線を押し広げ続け、敵を抑止し、国内の安全を確保するとともに、ウクライナをさらに強化することができるだろう」と述べた。

item.title: 米ＦＲＢ、大手銀行の監督巡り資産基準緩和を計画＝関係筋
item.description:
Nupur Anand Pete Schroeder Saeed Azhar
[ニューヨーク／ワシントン ２５日 ロイ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ＦＲＢ、大手銀行の監督巡り資産基準緩和を計画＝関係筋 9/25 19:10 配信

2015年12月撮影　REUTERS/Kevin Lamarque/File Photo

Nupur Anand　Pete Schroeder　Saeed Azhar

[ニューヨーク／ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が、大手銀行に対する厳格な監督を発動する資産規模の基準を引き上げる計画を進めていることが、関係者４人の話で明らかになった。実現すれば、一部の銀行はコストのかかる追加規制を回避できるようになり、業界再編を促す可能性がある。

関係者によると、ＦＲＢは近く、健全性審査（ストレステスト）や流動性、資本などに関するより厳格なルールが適用される資産規模の基準について、インフレと経済成長を反映するよう見直しを提案する見通し。関係者のうち３人は、ＦＲＢが年内にも変更案を提示するとみている。

現行の規則では、銀行の資産規模が１０００億ドルに達すると規制が厳しくなり、２５００億ドル、さらに７０００億ドルで段階的に強化される。銀行側は、２０１９年に設定されたこうした基準が経済実態に即しておらず、実際のリスクに見合わない厳しい監督を強いられていると主張している。

関係者によると、ＦＲＢは最上位の基準を１兆ドル近くに引き上げるほか、より低い基準で適用される規制の一部について、適用基準を１５００億ドル近くに引き上げる計画だ。

ＦＲＢ報道官はコメントを控えた。

ロイター 関連ニュース 長期金利が3.1％に上昇、30年ぶり高水準：識者はこうみる 焦点：ＦＲＢが狙う「雇用損なわない」インフレ抑制、コロナ禍後の再現なるか 焦点：トランプ氏の金利1％論、政権周辺でも異論　物価高批判そらす狙いか コラム：何が豪ドルを動かしているのか＝高島修氏 コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 最終更新: 9/25(金) 19:10 ロイター

item.title: Pact with Saudi and Pakistan could expand to Muslim world, including Iran, says Turkish speaker
item.description: Similar to NATO's Article 5, the "Mecca Joint Defence Agreement" stipulates that an attack on one ally constitutes an attack on all.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

Pact with Saudi and Pakistan could expand to Muslim world, including Iran, says Turkish speaker

Similar to NATO's Article 5, the "Mecca Joint Defence Agreement" stipulates that an attack on one ally constitutes an attack on all.

Turkey's Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan meets with Pakistan's Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Mohammad Ishaq Dar and Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud on the sidelines of the 81st United Nations General Assembly in New York City, US, on Sep 24, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Turkish Foreign Ministry)

FAST

ANKARA: A defence pact between Türkiye, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan could turn into a broader pact "for the Muslim world" that includes Iran, Türkiye's parliament speaker said on Friday (Sep 25), adding that it is expected to be submitted for ratification from next month. The regional powers signed the " Mecca Joint Defence Agreement " in August, weeks before Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis launched attacks against Saudi Arabia, in reaction to the wider Iran war. Similar to NATO's Article 5, the pact stipulates that an attack on one ally constitutes an attack on all. The signatories have met to lay out the accord's parameters and assess Riyadh's needs. "For international agreements to come into effect, parliamentary approval is needed. The meetings held as part of the agreement at the moment are preparatory meetings," Parliament Speaker Numan Kurtulmus told reporters in Ankara. "I expect this issue to come on the parliament's agenda in the coming period," he added, referring to parliament's return from recess in October. Asked whether the pact was against Iran, Kurtulmus repeated Türkiye's position that the agreement did not target any specific country but was primarily aimed at ensuring the security of states in the region amid conflicts and Israel's "hostile policies", adding that Tehran could potentially join the pact too. "We never see the Mecca Agreement as a pact against Iran, it must not be that way. In fact, we hope the Mecca Agreement can turn into a broader agreement for the Muslim world. Iran can join this agreement too, we hope it will become much stronger with the participation of other regional countries," he said. Ankara has previously said it could help meet Riyadh's military needs, especially on technical issues, but officials have said any support at this stage would be largely bilateral and in the spirit of their alliance, since the joint agreement has yet to be ratified. The military chiefs of Saudi Arabia, Türkiye and Pakistan are set to meet to discuss ways of supporting Riyadh.

item.title: ＵＡＥで3カ国協議、米が提案とウクライナ大統領 ロも近く開催示唆
item.description: ［キーウ／モスクワ ２５日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［キーウ／モスクワ　２５日　ロイター］ - 米国は、ロシアによるウクライナ侵攻終結に向けた取り組みを協議する米国、ロシア、ウクライナ３カ国の実務者協議をアラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）で開催することを提案した。ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領が２５日、明らかにした。

ゼレンスキー氏は対話アプリのワッツアップを通じた記者向け説明で、「米側は実務レベルでの３者形式の会合を提案した」と述べた。「日程に関する米国からの提案を待っている。米国は開催地の候補としてＵＡＥを提案した」とした。

ロシアのペスコフ大統領報道官も２５日、３カ国会合が近く開催される可能性があると述べた。ペスコフ氏は、ドミトリエフ大統領特別代表が米国を訪問しており、米交渉団と協議しているとした。関係筋によると、ドミトリエフ氏は２４日にウィトコフ、クシュナー両米代表と会談したとされる。

ゼレンスキー氏は２２日、国連総会が開かれている米ニューヨークでトランプ米大統領と会談した。会談後、エネルギー施設を対象とした停戦などについて協議したと明らかにし、ウクライナはロシアとのエネルギー停戦についていかなる形式にも応じる用意があるとしていた。

item.title: Americans navigate 'wild West' of health insurance options after dropping Obamacare plans
item.description: Some Americans are turning to skimpier plans or going without health insurance altogether as Obamacare plan premiums and deductibles rise.
item.dc:creator: Sriparna Roy
item.content:encoded: When Stacy Cox, a self-employed photographer in Kanab, Utah, dropped her Obamacare health insurance plan this year, routine preventive care became a financial dilemma. Now she finds herself weighing $1,200 for a mammogram against survival of her business. "It's scary," the 49-year-old Cox told Reuters. "Every month we come to the table and we have a discussion. Is it time to close a business? Is it time to seek employment somewhere in the hopes of gaining health insurance?" Cox is at high risk for breast cancer due to family history and has an autoimmune disease requiring regular medications. She is among 3 million Americans who [USN:L1N41O16Y TEXT:"dropped out of the Affordable Care Act marketplace"], created by President Barack Obama and often called Obamacare, due to sharp increases in premiums and deductibles at the beginning of 2026. The plans, which offer subsidies based on income, covered 19.2 million people as of February, according to government data. Expiration of enhanced COVID-era premium tax credits at the beginning of the year contributed to sharp cost increases. Cox is one of nearly a dozen Americans who told Reuters they shifted to skimpy, short-term health plans that provide less comprehensive coverage, or have joined health-sharing programs, where members pool monthly contributions to help pay each other's medical bills. Many Americans have opted to go without health insurance altogether, a situation that the ACA was originally meant to address. Several hospital operators have flagged rising costs tied to treating uninsured patients, including Universal Health Services (UHS.N) , a Pennsylvania-based hospital system with more than 500 facilities. In July, its CEO said it seemed most patients who had dropped ACA coverage were now uninsured. Enrollment data on short-term coverage remains limited. A spokesperson for the US Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services said these plans, which are primarily designed to help fill a temporary coverage gap, such as when someone is transitioning from an employer-based plan, are one of several options available. In the ACA marketplace, insurers have proposed a median premium increase of about 15% for 2027, according to health policy research group KFF, marking the second successive year of double-digit hikes. Enrollment for ACA plans opens November 1 and runs until January 15. UnitedHealth (UNH.N) , Elevance (ELV.N) , Centene (CNC.N) and Molina Healthcare (MOH.N) offer Obamacare plans. Some insurers, like UnitedHealth, also offer short-term plans. TURNING TO CHEAPER OPTIONS Ryan Shapiro, 56, from Frederick, Maryland, plans to wind down his photography business by year end and help his wife run her interior design business, in part due to the rising cost of healthcare. Shapiro dropped his ACA coverage for this year because his monthly premium was set to more than double to over $1,000. He instead chose a short-term plan that costs roughly $600 a month and covers hospitalization and critical illnesses. Under current federal rules, short-term plans are generally limited to three months, plus a one-month renewal. After CMS said last year it would stop enforcing that limit, several states allow longer coverage duration. "It's half the cost of full-blown health insurance," Shapiro said. "It's a way for us to kind of minimize our expenses should a health crisis happen." SKIPPING CARE Several people interviewed said they had postponed or skipped preventive care, annual checkups and other treatment because of high premiums and deductibles, opting to pay out of pocket for urgent care when necessary. "What do we do if one of us gets sick?" said Cox, who has skipped regular cancer screenings. "Do we just die? Because we sure can't afford to fight it, and that's a really scary place to be in." High deductibles have been another pain point, forcing patients to pay thousands of dollars out of pocket for medical services before insurance coverage kicks in. Some also said their plans offered a narrow choice of doctors. Some people have turned to health-sharing programs, often organized by religious groups, that typically do not provide consumer protections. Cristin Connelly, a 53-year-old public relations consultant in Atlanta, joined Zion HealthShare in 2025 after dropping her ACA plan. She pays $480 a month for herself and her young adult children, which includes an annual preventive doctor's visit for each family member, one mammogram a year and a colonoscopy every other year, among other services. Her plan has a minimum spend of $5,000 for submission, a de facto deductible Zion refers to as an initial unshareable amount individual members must pay before medical expenses become eligible for the community sharing pool. Zion HealthShare, which has more than 78,000 active members, has no religious requirements. "My experience with insurance is it's such a hassle to get things paid. They deny claims all the time and then say they're only paying a portion of it," said Connelly. Her health-share experience "so far has been that when I ask for a self-pay rate for anything, it's much less." She said she hopes to move off the health share in the long run. Experts say health-sharing arrangements and other non-traditional products carry significant limitations. Many states do not adequately police aggressive or deceptive marketing practices, said Sabrina Corlette, a research professor at Georgetown University's Center on Health Insurance Reforms, leaving consumers vulnerable. "There really and truly is a bit of a wild, wild West out there with respect to these products," Corlette said. "Some of them are legit, some of them not so legit, very much buyer beware!"

item.title: Rush of money, campaign stops show Republicans feel vulnerable in Iowa, Kansas
item.description: Farm-belt states like these normally form the party’s safest territory.
item.dc:creator: Renee Hickman, Dawn Kopecki
item.content:encoded: With midterm elections just over a month away, Republican heavyweights have been jetting across the country to campaign and outside groups have been pouring money into races in what is normally the party’s safest territory -- Farm Belt states like Iowa and Kansas. The influx of money and attention shows just how vulnerable Republicans are as high costs, especially for gasoline and diesel, have disappointed the party’s usual supporters, according to campaign strategists and political scientists. Republican voters have increasingly soured on President Donald Trump's handling of the economy, part of why his approval rating fell to 32% in a September 21 Reuters/Ipsos poll, the lowest of his political career. "The spending reflects just how competitive these races are,” said Republican strategist Brad Dayspring of Purple Strategies in Alexandria, Virginia. "Republicans are fighting for their political future and they're using every arrow in the quiver to make sure their message breaks through." Vice President JD Vance recently campaigned in Iowa on behalf of US Senate candidate Ashley Hinson, and earlier in the year for Republican Representative Zach Nunn. Vance also made a stop in Kansas, where a Democrat has not been elected senator since the Great Depression, to rally support for Republican Senator Roger “Doc” Marshall. Those two states, as well as Nebraska, where incumbent Republican Pete Ricketts is facing independent Dan Osborn, look competitive as the general election nears. Senator John Kennedy of Louisiana also recently traveled to all three to campaign for Republicans. "If you told me six months ago I was going to be having to spend my time in those three states, I wouldn’t have believed you,” Kennedy said. “Those oughta be fat guy layups for us.” FARM BELT FEELS THE EFFECTS For the first time, Republicans who disapprove of Trump's handling of the cost of living outnumber those who approve 51% to 44%, according to the September 21 poll. The war with Iran has caused diesel fuel prices to [USN:L6N4580TA TEXT:"surge"] to more than $6.50 a gallon, a record. Diesel is used to power vehicles like pickup trucks and farm equipment, making the increase particularly painful in states like Iowa, Kansas and Nebraska, where agriculture is a dominant industry. In Iowa, Hinson is facing an increasingly tough battle with Democrat Josh Turek, a state representative from Council Bluffs, on the western edge of the state. A Marist poll on September 22 showed her running behind Turek, with 42% of respondents supporting Hinson to Turek's 50%. A sitting member of the US House of Representatives, Hinson previously voted six times against House measures seeking to curb Trump's authority to continue the Iran war. Following Vance's September 18 visit, Hinson reversed course, calling for a [USN:L1N45D0Y8 TEXT:"swift end"] to the war. Hinson did not attend the rally headlined by Vance. Speaking at the event, he called her an "amazing public servant" and vowed to get her elected even though, "I know she couldn't be here today." Republican-aligned political action committees have poured more than $30.3 million into the campaign, with more than $11.7 million coming since Labor Day. Democrats have spent $24.3 million to boost Turek, with about $7.6 million coming since Labor Day, according to federal election filings, which do not include nonprofit groups that are not required to disclose their spending. KANSAS LOOKING COMPETITIVE Vance made the trip to Kansas as Marshall, a former obstetrician who was elected in 2020, faced reports that he has sued more than 700 patients for unpaid medical debts. A Marshall spokesperson told the New York Times in response to their reporting that he treated patients regardless of whether they could pay. Recent polling from Emerson College/Nexstar Media put Marshall's Democratic challenger, church pastor Adam Hamilton, within the margin of error when pitted against Marshall. The poll showed 45% of voters supporting Hamilton and 43% supporting the Republican senator. If Hamilton won, he would be the first Democratic senator elected from Kansas in 94 years. Outside Democratic groups started targeting the race at the end of August, pouring in about $2.3 million, according to Federal Election Commission data, indicating they see the potential for Hamilton to unseat the incumbent Marshall. Republican-leaning groups have put about $1.6 million into the race, but just $27,500 since Labor Day. Visits by high-profile figures like Vance are often used to generate more turnout among loyal voters in midterm elections, whose outcome usually depends on getting the party's staunchest supporters to the polls. Those visits can backfire, said Alexandra Middlewood, professor of political science at Wichita State University. Kansas has large numbers of independent voters less likely to be swayed by the backing of big names, she said. In a year when Republicans and Trump are increasingly unpopular, visits like Vance's could reinforce negative sentiments. Ron Bonjean, a partner at bipartisan public affairs firm Rokk Solutions, said of Vance's visit to Iowa: "If the vice president is going into a Republican stronghold this late into a campaign, it shows that they want to shore up support to ensure there aren’t problems on election day."

item.title: Hurt by Trump, Senate Republicans plan to bolster affordability credentials before midterms
item.description: They hope to win over voters struggling with inflation stoked by Trump's war in Iran.
item.dc:creator: David Morgan
item.content:encoded: US Senate Republicans aim to improve their election prospects by voting on legislation that seeks to protect consumers from rising electricity bills caused by data centers, hoping to win over voters struggling with inflation stoked by President Donald Trump's war with Iran. Republicans had the option to depart Washington on Thursday and stay out until after the November 3 midterm election. But they chose to return next week to take up the Ratepayer Protection Act at the behest of Senator Jon Husted, who is trailing the Democratic candidate, former Senator Sherrod Brown, in Ohio, a state Trump won by more than 11 points in 2024. Republicans believe their votes in favor of the bill will demonstrate their commitment to helping voters focused on a cost-of-living crisis, with polls showing broad opposition to data centers despite Trump's support for their development. Holding a vote on the bill is the latest sign of Republican anxiety in the face of [USN:L6N45D0NV TEXT:"Trump's record-low approval rating"] less than six weeks before Election Day, when Republicans hope to retain control of the Senate and House of Representatives. This angst has prompted Republicans to find ways to break with Trump and address voter frustrations that analysts say have raised Democratic hopes even in traditionally Republican states such as Kansas and Nebraska. REPUBLICANS CALL FOR END TO IRAN WAR Senate Republican candidates [USN:L1N45D0Y8 TEXT:"Mike Rogers of Michigan and Ashley Hinson of Iowa"], who are locked in tight election contests, have called for a quick end to the Iran war, which has disrupted oil supplies and caused energy prices to surge. Other Republicans including Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas have begun voicing concern about immigration enforcement operations in their states, one of Trump's signature initiatives. "It's not a great environment. There are headwinds we're facing in all the races around the country," said Senate Majority Leader John Thune. He told reporters earlier this week that demonstrating independence from Trump on issues important to local constituents was the best way for Republican candidates to win. Trump's approval ratings have fallen even among Republicans, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll showing party support for the president dropping nine points to 73% over the course of a week. In key battleground states such as Georgia, Iowa, Maine, North Carolina and Texas, the president's approval ratings reported by polling analytics firm Civiqs were double digits below his share of the 2024 presidential election vote. Though Trump is not on the November ballot, he has remained at the center of the campaign and dominated a Republican convention in Dallas this month intended to boost Republican candidates for Congress. "The election cycle is about Trump, and he's not given anybody anything to vote for other than his MAGA agenda," said Chuck Coughlin, an independent strategist who heads the Arizona-based firm Highground Inc. Up to now, Republicans have promoted tax cuts contained in Trump's One Big Beautiful Bill, which went into effect in 2025, as evidence of their effort to address affordability, while contrasting themselves with Democrats on transgender issues and other culture-war topics. ACTING ON ELECTRICITY RATES Data centers are proliferating as artificial intelligence requires increasing computing power. Costs for grid upgrades needed to meet data centers' massive energy demands have in many cases been passed on to residential electricity consumers. The Ratepayer Protection Act would require state utility regulators to consider whether large electricity users including data centers should bear the incremental costs of power infrastructure built to serve them. It passed the House of Representatives in [USN:S0N441000 TEXT:"a 417-3 vote"]. A procedural vote was expected in the Senate on Wednesday. Democrats, who blocked an attempt by Husted last week to pass the legislation through unanimous consent, said the bill does not go far enough to protect consumers. They have proposed the GRID Savings Act, which would require large data centers to pay the full cost of grid upgrades needed to serve them. "Senator Husted's bill is a fraud. It's voluntary. No company has to do it. The bill we have is mandatory. It is much stronger," Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer told reporters. Given Democratic opposition, Republicans hope to use next week's vote to show the public that they, not Democrats, are ready to address high costs. "They say they're for more affordability. This is a chance for everybody to prove it," Husted told reporters.

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝香港株続落、保険・テック株主導　中国休場 9/25 19:02 配信

［香港　２５日　ロイター］ - 香港株式市場は続落して終了した。祝日を控えて薄商いとなる中、保険株とハイテク株が下げを主導した。習近平国家主席とトランプ米大統領による前日の首脳会談の詳細を見極めようとする動きとなった。

ハンセン指数は１％安の２万４５１０．０９と、２カ月ぶりの安値を付けた。ハンセン中国株指数は１．２％下落した。

保険株とハイテク株が売られ、ＡＩＡが２．７％安、アリババが１．５％安となった。中秋節の祝日を控えて商いは薄かった。中国本土市場は休場で、２８日に取引を再開する。

ＵＢＰのアジア担当シニアエコノミスト、カルロス・カサノバ氏は、米中の貿易休戦は延長されたものの、技術、投資、地政学を巡る根本的な対立は解消されていないと指摘。「次の重要な試金石は深センで開かれるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議になる」と語った。

item.description: [ロンドン ２５日 ロイター] - モルガン・スタンレーは２５日、英金利見通しを修正し、イングランド銀行（英中央銀...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英利上げ、11月と2月に実施へ＝モルガンＳ 9/25 18:08 配信

モルガン・スタンレーのロゴ。2025年12月に撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[ロンドン ２５日 ロイター] - モルガン・スタンレーは２５日、英金利見通しを修正し、イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）が１１月と来年２月にそれぞれ２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げを実施すると予測した。これまでは利上げが当面ないと見込んでいた。

アナリストらはリサーチノートで「われわれはイングランド銀行の見通しを、四半期ごとの２回の利上げへと正式に修正する。財政政策がさらなる引き締めへの主要な潜在的カタリストになると考えている」と説明。「年末年始には成長の鈍化が見込まれるが、世界的な成長の堅調さを踏まえると、短期的なリスクは均衡するとわれわれは見ている」と述べた。

item.description: [フランクフルト ２５日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が２５日発表したデータによると、８月のユーロ圏の企...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ユーロ圏8月銀行融資、企業向けは小幅減速　家計向け横ばい 9/25 17:55 配信

パリ近郊ピュトーの金融・ビジネス地区。6月23日に撮影。REUTERS/Abdul Saboor

[フランクフルト ２５日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が２５日発表したデータによると、８月のユーロ圏の企業向け融資の伸び率は、比較的高水準だった前月から小幅に鈍化した。家計向けは横ばいだった。

企業向け融資は前年同月比４．２％増と、２０２３年半ば以来の高水準だった７月の４．４％から減速した。家計向けは３．１％増と、２３年初め以来の高水準を維持した。

マネーサプライＭ３の伸び率は前月の３．４％から３．５％に加速した。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想と一致した。

item.description:

[東京 ２５日 ロイター] - インパクトのある新事業を創出したスタートアップを表彰す...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
政府主催スタートアップ大賞にＭｕｊｉｎ、情報通信はサカナＡＩ 9/25 17:35 配信

Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 ２５日 ロイター] - インパクトのある新事業を創出したスタートアップを表彰する政府主催の「日本スタートアップ大賞２０２６」の受賞企業が２５日、発表され、大賞（内閣総理大臣賞）に知能ロボットコントローラー開発・販売のＭｕｊｉｎ（ムジン、東京都江東区）が選ばれた。情報通信スタートアップ賞にはサカナＡＩ（東京都港区）が選出された。

Ｍｕｊｉｎは物流・製造現場の作業を自動化する「汎用的知能ロボットコントローラ」を提供している。滝野一征最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）はロイターの取材に、フィジカルＡＩ（人工知能）は日本に強みがあるとし「ディープテックの戦いというのは国と国の戦い。（自社への）授賞はそこをしっかり国としてサポートし、国策にまで上げるんだという決意だと思う」と話した。

サカナＡＩの共同創業者・社長の伊藤錬氏は「技術を作るだけでなく、世の役に立てるというところが評価されたのかなと思う」と話した。金融機関の融資業務支援や、防衛省・自衛隊向けの安全保障領域などで実装されているとし、今後の展望として「高市早苗首相ではないが防衛をやってやってやりまくる。そうすれば防衛用に作ったものがインフラや物流、電力など民生用にも使えるようになる」と語った。

防衛スタートアップ賞には水上ドローン（ＵＳＶ＝無人水上艇 ）を展開するオーシャニック・コンステレーションズ （神奈川県鎌倉市）が選出された。本田拓馬共同代表は「安全保障は重要な社会命題。まずは人命リスクを抱えながら自衛隊の皆さんがやっているような警戒監視に無人機を適用することでしっかり貢献していきたい」と話した。

高市政権は、成長基盤の強化に向けたスタートアップ支援を主要政策の一つに掲げている。

item.title: サンケイＲＥ、旧村上ファンド系のＴＯＢに賛同表明
item.description: [東京 ２５日 ロイター] - 不動産投資信託（ＲＥＩＴ）のサンケイリアルエステート投資法人は２５日、旧村上ファンド...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
サンケイＲＥ、旧村上ファンド系のＴＯＢに賛同表明 9/25 16:59 配信

[東京 ２５日 ロイター] - 不動産投資信託（ＲＥＩＴ）のサンケイリアルエステート投資法人は２５日、旧村上ファンド系の投資会社、シティインデックフィフス（東京都渋谷区）による同投資口に対する公開買い付け（ＴＯＢ）に賛同の意見を表明すると同時に、ＴＯＢ応募の是非について投資主の判断に委ねることを決議したと発表した。

シティインデックスフィフスはサンケイＲＥの非公開化を目的に９月２８日から１１月１０日に投資口１口当たり１２万５０００円でＴＯＢを計画している。２５日の終値は前日比２％高の１０万７２００円だった。買い付け予定数の下限は１１万８７３２口とした。

サンケイＲＥを巡っては、不動産事業を手がけるトーセイ などが１月から５月まで実施したＴＯＢが不成立に終わっていた。その後、旧村上ファンド系の投資会社、シティインデックスイレブンス（東京都渋谷区）が共同保有者の野村絢氏らとの合計で２９．９０％を保有していることが８月７日提出の変更報告書で分かっている。

野村氏らは今回のＴＯＢには応募せずに、成立した際に非公開化のための手続きに応じる予定。

item.description: 香港株式市場は続落して終了した。祝日を控えて薄商いとなる中、保険株とハイテク株が下げを主導した。習近平国家主席とトランプ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アジア株式市場サマリー：引け（25日） 9/25 16:57 配信

香港株式市場は続落して終了した。祝日を控えて薄商いとなる中、保険株とハイテク株が下げを主導した。習近平国家主席とトランプ米大統領による前日の首脳会談の詳細を見極めようとする動きとなった。    ハンセン指数は１％安の２万４５１０．０９と、２カ月ぶりの安値を付けた。ハンセン中国株指数は１．２％下落した。    保険株とハイテク株が売られ、ＡＩＡが２．７％安、アリババが１．５％安となった。中秋節の祝日を控えて商いは薄かった。中国本土市場は休場で、２８日に取引を再開する。    ＵＢＰのアジア担当シニアエコノミスト、カルロス・カサノバ氏は、米中の貿易休戦は延長されたものの、技術、投資、地政学を巡る根本的な対立は解消されていないと指摘。「次の重要な試金石は深センで開かれるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議になる」と語った。

シドニー株式市場は下落して引けた。インフレ懸念の再燃で世界的に債券が売られリスク選好が後退した。翌週にオーストラリア準備銀行（中央銀行、ＲＢＡ）の政策会合を控える中、週間でも４週連続の下落となった。

Ｓ＆Ｐ／ＡＳＸ２００指数は週間では０．８％下落。

北海ブレント先物は０．８％安と小幅に下げたものの、１バレル＝１００ドルを上回る水準を維持し、インフレ懸念が根強く、世界的な債券利回り上昇の要因となった。

前日発表された月次の雇用統計がまちまちの内容となったことを受け、市場の関心は翌週のＲＢＡ政策会合に移っている。根強いインフレに対応するため、利上げが広く見込まれている。投資家は決定そのものよりも、９月会合以降の金融政策の方向性を示唆する中銀のトーンに注目する。

鉱業株指数は０．８％安。産金株指数は金価格の軟化を受け０．５％下落。エネルギー株指数は米国とイランの停戦期待から原油価格が下げたことで０．３％安となった。

ハイテク株指数は１．７％安で、週間では６週連続の下落となった。

銀行株指数は０．３％上昇し、四大銀行はいずれも０．６─１．１％高となった。ただ、週間では０．６％下落し、３週連続の下げとなった。ＫＣＭトレードのチーフマーケットアナリスト、ティム・ ウォーターラー氏は「金融株はここ７週間でほとんどを軟調となっている。市場が利上げサイクルの長期化ないし積極化の影響を織り込んでいるためだ」と指摘。金利上昇は当初こそ銀行の純金利マージンを支えるが、成長減速や信用の質への圧力に対する懸念が強まっていると述べた。

item.description: [東京 ２５日 ロイター] - 石油・天然ガス開発のＩＮＰＥＸは２５日、ＪＥＲＡが保有する豪州のイクシスＬＮＧ（液化天...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＩＮＰＥＸ、豪イクシスＬＮＧの権益0.73％追加取得　ＪＥＲＡが売却先変更 9/25 16:50 配信

石油・天然ガス開発のＩＮＰＥＸのロゴ。8月12日、東京で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

[東京 ２５日 ロイター] - 石油・天然ガス開発のＩＮＰＥＸは２５日、ＪＥＲＡが保有する豪州のイクシスＬＮＧ（液化天然ガス）プロジェクトの参加権益０．７３５％を取得する契約を締結したと発表した。先買権の行使によるもので、取得後の同プロジェクトにおけるＩＮＰＥＸの参加権益の比率は６７．８２％から６８．５５５％に上昇する。

豪州政府の規制当局による承認などの先行条件が整い次第、契約が発効する。ＪＥＲＡは２０２５年１２月、同権益を保有する豪州のプロジェクト子会社をミッドオーシャン・エナジーに譲渡することを決定していた。もともと権益を持つＩＮＰＥＸが、同じ条件で買い取ることができる権利を行使する。

ＩＮＰＥＸは、今回の取得が日本やアジアへのエネルギーの安定供給や、エネルギー自主開発比率の維持・確保につながるとしている。連結業績への影響は軽微という。

一方、ＪＥＲＡは売却先変更によるＬＮＧ調達への影響はないと発表した。既存の売買契約に基づき、イクシス事業からＬＮＧの引き取りを続ける。

item.title: 日経平均は5日続伸、半導体関連株けん引 銀行株高がＴＯＰＩＸ高に寄与
item.description:
Noriyuki Hirata
[東京 ２５日 ロイター] - 東京株式市場で日経平均は５日続伸し、前営業日比１．３０...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
日経平均は5日続伸、半導体関連株けん引　銀行株高がＴＯＰＩＸ高に寄与 9/25 16:13 配信

東京証券取引所。4月6日、東京で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

Noriyuki Hirata

[東京 ２５日 ロイター] - 東京株式市場で日経平均は５日続伸し、前営業日比１．３０％（８５０円２１銭）高の６万６３６４円２０銭で取引を終えた。寄与度の高い半導体関連株が上昇をけん引した。金利が上昇基調にある中、配当権利取りへの期待が重なって銀行株が買われ、ＴＯＰＩＸの押し上げに寄与した。

朝方には円金利の上昇基調が強まり、株価の上値が抑えられる場面もあったが、原油価格の上昇が一服する中、徐々に水準を切り上げた。アドバンテストや東京エレクトロン、イビデンといった半導体関連株の上昇が指数を押し上げ、午後にかけて堅調に推移した。

ＴＯＰＩＸの上昇率は、日経平均の上昇率と同程度となった。金利高による利ざや改善期待、円安を背景にした早期利上げへの思惑、配当狙いの買いへの期待などが重なり、ＴＯＰＩＸへの寄与度の高い銀行株の上昇に弾みがついた。週明け２８日が権利付き最終売買日でもあり「それまでバリュー株の優位が続きそうだ」（りそなホールディングス市場企画部武居大暉ストラテジスト）との見方が聞かれた。

ＴＯＰＩＸは１．３１％高の４１２８．５９ポイントで取引を終えた。東証プライム市場指数は前営業日比１．３１％高の２１２９．９３ポイントだった。プライム市場の売買代金は７兆８００８億８１００万円。東証３３業種では、値上がりは銀行や証券、その他金融など３１業種、値下がりは情報・通信、建設の２業種だった。

山形銀行や阿波銀行といった地銀がプライム市場の値上がり率上位に並んだ。株式公開買い付け（ＴＯＢ）の思惑が出た小林製薬はストップ高比例配分となった。一方、ソフトバンクグループは軟調。同社が参画し米国で人工知能（ＡＩ）インフラを構築する「スターゲート」計画の一環とされるデータセンタープロジェクトで、米ＩＴ大手オラクルが投資運用会社に賃料支払いを遅らせる通知をしたと伝わり、嫌気された。清水建設はさえなかった。

新興株式市場は、東証グロース市場２５０指数が続落し、０．９５％安の８００．５５ポイントだった。スタンダード市場に新規上場したレイヤードの初値は公開価格を５９．２％上回る２２３０円で、終値は２１１１円となり初値を下回った。

東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが１１１８銘柄（７１％）、値下がりは３８２銘柄（２４％）、変わらずは５４銘柄（３％）だった。

午後3時のドルは158円前半で上値重い、2経済閣僚の発言を材料視 9/25 15:54 配信

写真は米ドル紙幣。2025年3月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Kentaro Sugiyama

[東京 ２５日 ロイター] -

ドル／円 ユーロ／ドル ユーロ／円

午後３時現在 158.24／158.28 1.1374／1.1376 180.02／180.03

午前９時現在 158.82／158.86 1.1371／1.1377 180.65／180.67

ＮＹ午後５時 158.83／158.88 1.1379／1.1382 180.74／180.84

午後３時のドル／円は、前日ニューヨーク市場終盤に比べてドル安／円高の１５８円前半で推移している。片山さつき財務相が午前の閣議後会見で、トランプ米大統領が先日の日米首脳会談で円安に懸念を示していたと明らかにし、午後にかけて上値が重くなった。

ドル／円は朝方にきょうの高値１５８．８９円をつけた後、弱含みの展開となった。米国の金利上昇が経済にどのような影響を与えるか予想しにくい中、為替市場でもいったんポジションを手仕舞う動きが出やすい状況となっている。午後３時すぎには一時１５７円台へ下落した。

片山氏の発言が円安けん制と受け止められたことに加え、城内実・経済財政相がほぼ同時刻に行われた会見で、金融緩和をしながら財政政策を進める「アベノミクス的な意味でのリフレ政策は終わっている」と認識を示したことも「円安からの転換を意識させている」（三井住友銀行の鈴木浩史チーフ為替ストラテジスト）という。

日銀が午後発表した８月の消費者物価のコア指標は、生鮮食品と「特殊要因」を除いた消費者物価指数（特殊要因を除くコアＣＰＩ）が前年比２．６％上昇。７月の２．３％から伸びが加速した。

日銀は基調的な物価上昇率の上振れリスクを警戒しており、今後、追加利上げを巡る議論の支援材料となる可能性がある。

item.content:encoded:
8月百貨店売上2.6％増、高額品がけん牽引＝百貨店協会 9/25 15:40 配信

写真は2024年6月、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

[東京 ２５日 ロイター] - 日本百貨店協会が２５日に発表した８月の全国百貨店売上高は、店舗数調整後で前年同月比２．６％増の４２２１億円だった。前年同月を上回るのは８カ月連続。豪雨や台風の影響で一部店舗が休業や営業時間の短縮を余儀なくされたものの、高額品が引き続き好調で全体をけん引した。

売上高全体の約１割を占めるインバウンド（免税売上）は同４．６％増の４６１億円と、６カ月連続で前年同月を上回った。円安を背景に高額品の需要が堅調だった。台湾、香港、韓国からの客による売り上げが伸びる一方、中国は同１７％減とマイナスに転じ、客数も同３７％減と落ち込みが拡大した。

全体の約９割を占める国内売上高は同２．４％増と、２カ月連続のプラス。物価高の影響で日常使いの食料品は伸び悩んだものの、帰省みやげの需要や人が集まる機会の増加を背景に、菓子や総菜が堅調だった。
